title_en: The SR-71 Blackbird Was Never Built To Exceed Mach 3.3, According To Its Record Pilot
title_zh: 据飞行员记录，SR-71 黑鸟的飞行速度从未超过 3.3 马赫
summary: Discover why the SR-71 Blackbird’s incredible speed came with strict operational limits, despite its ability to outrun many threats.
summary_zh: 了解为什么 SR-71 黑鸟尽管能够逃脱许多威胁，但其令人难以置信的速度却伴随着严格的操作限制。
body_en: Chris earned a Master’s degree in Defense and Strategic Studies (Highest Honors) from the University of Texas at El Paso.
His graduate work concentrated on Global and National Security, Low-Intensity Conflict, Modern Warfare, and US grand strategy.
He also undertook extensive regional studies, analyzing how key regions integrate into the broader US security architecture.
This rigorous program provided him with a comprehensive understanding of U.S. military operations, global strategy, and weapons systems.
Additionally, he gained a strong appreciation for great power competition.—an increasingly central force shaping international relations and conflict for the foreseeable future.

The Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird remains one of the most remarkable aircraft ever built. Designed to conduct strategic reconnaissance over hostile territory during the Cold War, the Mach 3-capable spy plane combined extraordinary speed, high-altitude flight, and advanced technology to gather intelligence while avoiding enemy air defenses. However, despite its reputation as one of the fastest aircraft ever flown, the SR-71 was not intended to push its performance to the absolute limit on every mission.

According to Ed Yeilding, one of the SR-71's record-setting pilots, the Blackbird was never built to exceed Mach 3.3. Its operational limits reflected more than the capabilities of its powerful engines, with engineering constraints, fuel consumption, and mission requirements all influencing how the Blackbird was flown. Yet, the aircraft's value extended well beyond its speed, as it provided the United States with critical intelligence on Soviet military activity throughout the Cold War.
The Iconic And Awe-Inspiring SR-71 Blackbird And Why It Was Built

The SR-71 was purpose-built to operate at immense altitudes and speeds. This requirement was driven by significant advances in Soviet radar and surface-to-air missile (SAM) technology. The latter was demonstrated within five years of the Lockheed Martin U-2 spy plane entering operational service in 1956 .

The primary threat to the U-2 was the Soviet SA-2 SAM. Propelled by a liquid-fuel rocket, it was launched from a reusable launcher capable of accommodating six missiles and rotating 360 degrees. The missile had a ceiling of approximately 60,000 feet (18,288 meters), a maximum speed of Mach 3.5, and a 288 lb (130.6 kg) blast-fragmentation warhead. This weapon was designed to destroy aircraft and deny access to Soviet airspace to reconnaissance planes and combat aircraft seeking to attack the Soviet Union or its allies.

According to NASA , the Blackbird design program originated in complete secrecy during the late 1950s. The SR-71 completed its maiden flight on December 22, 1964, with Lockheed Skunk Works Chief Test Pilot Robert J. “Bob” Gilliland at the controls. The aircraft officially entered service in 1966 with the 4200th (later 9th) Strategic Reconnaissance Wing at Beale Air Force Base in California. Once airborne, the SR-71 generally operated at altitudes between 80,000 and 85,000 feet (approximately 24,000 to 26,000 meters).

At such immense heights, 95 % of the Earth's atmosphere would be below its fuselage, and its cameras could survey 100,000 square miles (258,999 square km) of the Earth's surface per hour, allowing the Blackbird to capture detailed images across vast geographic areas. From these altitudes, the aircraft discreetly gathered sensitive intelligence on America's Cold War adversaries. This information helped intelligence agencies track changes in the deployment of large forward-positioned military units that might pose an immediate threat, monitor military exercises, and observe the construction of new military infrastructure, including ballistic missile silos and air base facilities.

To keep the crew and aircraft firmly out of reach of interceptors and the dreaded SAMs, the SR-71 was equipped with two massive and exceptionally powerful engines. The Blackbird was powered by two Pratt & Whitney J58 engines, each capable of producing an incredible 32,500 lb (14,742 kg) of thrust with afterburner. Furthermore, the SR-71 could cruise at Mach 3 continuously for more than one hour.

Once the aircraft reached cruising speed, the engine's inlet system and adjustable centerbody spike played a critical role in generating additional thrust. The design redirected much of the incoming airflow around the turbojet core and toward the afterburner and ejector nozzle, allowing the propulsion system to function in a manner similar to a ramjet. To withstand the immense heat generated while operating at such speeds and at altitudes of 80,000 to 85,000 feet (24,384 to 25,908 meters), the SR-71 airframes were constructed almost entirely of titanium and other exotic alloys. Temperatures could reach 600°F (316°C).

Operating at such immense speeds allowed the Blackbird to evade not only hostile aircraft intent on destroying it, but also enemy SAMs. Regarding the latter, Smithsonian reports that SR-71 crews were fired upon more than 4,000 times, with no hits—a testament to the aircraft's speed and meticulous engineering. While not a single Blackbird came close to being shot down, its ability to evade every weapon system designed to turn lesser aircraft into debris came at the cost of tremendous fuel consumption. During a standard 90-minute flight, the SR-71 would consume approximately 12,000 gallons (45,425 liters) of specialized JP-7 fuel.
The SR-71 Was Not Designed To Exceed Extremely High Mach

Former SR-71 pilot Ed Yeilding offered insight into the Blackbird’s speed limitations following his record-setting coast-to-coast flight on March 6, 1990. Flying with reconnaissance systems officer Joseph “J.T.” Vida, Yeilding helped establish multiple speed records during the aircraft’s final flight before it was delivered to the Smithsonian Institution. Although the Blackbird was well-known for flying above Mach 3, Yeilding explained that the Blackbird's flight manual did not display an operating speed beyond Mach 3.3. “Our flight manual had no mention of speed above Mach 3.3,” he recalled. This distinction is important when considering claims about the SR-71’s ultimate speed and the limits within which its pilots were expected to operate.

Yeilding also addressed reports that the SR-71 could reach Mach 3.4 or higher, including the claim that its limiting speed was Mach 3.55. He expressed respect for the late pilot David Peters and said he had “no doubt that he flew Mach 3.4+ in an area of extreme cold.” However, Yeilding had never heard of the Mach 3.55 limit and contacted experienced SR-71 pilot and test pilot school graduate BC Thomas, who also was not aware of the aircraft making it to such speeds. Yeilding’s own experience during the 1990 record flight demonstrated that Mach 3.3 was achievable in cruise , although fuel consumption remained a serious consideration. The crew could not maintain top speed across the entire route without risking insufficient fuel for landing.
body_zh: 克里斯在德克萨斯大学埃尔帕索分校获得了国防和战略研究硕士学位（最高荣誉）。
他的研究生工作主要集中在全球和国家安全、低强度冲突、现代战争和美国大战略。
他还进行了广泛的地区研究，分析关键地区如何融入更广泛的美国安全架构。
这个严格的项目使他对美国的军事行动、全球战略和武器系统有了全面的了解。
此外，他对大国竞争产生了强烈的认识——在可预见的未来，这种竞争将成为塑造国际关系和冲突的日益重要的力量。
洛克希德 SR-71 黑鸟仍然是有史以来最卓越的飞机之一。这款能够在冷战期间对敌方领土进行战略侦察的侦察机具有 3 马赫的飞行速度、高空飞行能力和先进技术，可在避开敌方防空系统的同时收集情报。然而，尽管 SR-71 被誉为有史以来最快的飞机之一，但它并不打算在每次任务中将其性能推向绝对极限。
据 SR-71 创纪录飞行员之一埃德·耶尔丁 (Ed Yeilding) 介绍，黑鸟的飞行速度从未超过 3.3 马赫。它的操作限制不仅仅反映了其强大发动机的能力，工程限制、燃油消耗和任务要求都影响着黑鸟的飞行方式。然而，这架飞机的价值远远超出了它的速度，因为它为美国提供了整个冷战期间苏联军事活动的关键情报。
标志性且令人惊叹的 SR-71 Blackbird 及其诞生原因
SR-71 专为在极高的高度和速度下运行而设计。这一要求是由苏联雷达和地对空导弹（SAM）技术的重大进步推动的。后者在洛克希德·马丁公司 U-2 间谍机 1956 年投入使用后的五年内得到了演示。
U-2 的主要威胁是苏联 SA-2 地对空导弹。它由液体燃料火箭推动，从可重复使用的发射器发射，该发射器可容纳六枚导弹并可 360 度旋转。该导弹的升限约为 60,000 英尺（18,288 米），最大速度为 3.5 马赫，拥有 288 磅（130.6 千克）的爆炸破片弹头。这种武器的目的是摧毁飞机并阻止侦察机和试图攻击苏联或其盟国的战斗机进入苏联领空。

据 NASA 称，黑鸟设计计划起源于 20 世纪 50 年代末完全保密的情况。 SR-71 于 1964 年 12 月 22 日完成首飞，由洛克希德臭鼬工厂首席试飞员罗伯特·J·“鲍勃”·吉利兰驾驶。该飞机于 1966 年正式进入加利福尼亚州比尔空军基地的第 4200 战略侦察联队（后来的第 9 联队）服役。一旦升空，SR-71 通常在 80,000 至 85,000 英尺（约 24,000 至 26,000 米）的高度运行。
在如此巨大的高度，地球大气层的 95% 将位于其机身下方，其相机每小时可勘测 100,000 平方英里（258,999 平方公里）的地球表面，使黑鸟能够捕捉广阔地理区域的详细图像。从这些高度，飞机谨慎地收集有关美国冷战对手的敏感情报。这些信息帮助情报机构跟踪可能构成直接威胁的大型前沿军事部队的部署变化，监测军事演习，并观察新军事基础设施的建设，包括弹道导弹发射井和空军基地设施。
为了使机组人员和飞机远离拦截弹和可怕的地对空导弹，SR-71 配备了两台巨大且异常强大的发动机。黑鸟由两台普惠 J58 发动机提供动力，每台发动机都能够在加力的情况下产生令人难以置信的 32,500 磅（14,742 公斤）推力。此外，SR-71可以以3马赫的速度连续巡航一小时以上。

一旦飞机达到巡航速度，发动机的进气系统和可调节中心体尖峰在产生额外推力方面发挥了关键作用。该设计将涡轮喷气发动机核心周围的大部分进入气流重新引导至加力燃烧器和喷射器喷嘴，从而使推进系统能够以类似于冲压发动机的方式运行。为了承受在如此速度和 80,000 至 85,000 英尺（24,384 至 25,908 米）高度运行时产生的巨大热量，SR-71 机身几乎完全由钛和其他特殊合金制成。温度可能达到 600°F (316°C)。

以如此巨大的速度运行，黑鸟不仅可以躲避意图摧毁它的敌方飞机，还可以躲避敌方的地对空导弹。关于后者，史密森尼报告称，SR-71 机组人员遭到了 4,000 多次射击，但没有命中——这证明了飞机的速度和精心设计。虽然没有一架黑鸟接近被击落，但它能够躲避所有旨在将小型飞机变成碎片的武器系统，但其代价是巨大的燃油消耗。在标准的 90 分钟飞行中，SR-71 将消耗大约 12,000 加仑（45,425 升）的专用 JP-7 燃料。
SR-71 的设计初衷并不是为了超过极高马赫数

1990 年 3 月 6 日，前 SR-71 飞行员艾德·耶尔丁 (Ed Yeilding) 创下了从东海岸到西海岸的飞行纪录，他深入了解了黑​​鸟的速度限制。与侦察系统官员约瑟夫“J.T.”一起飞行在飞机交付给史密森学会之前的最后一次飞行中，维达·耶尔丁 (Vida Yeilding) 帮助创造了多项速度记录。尽管黑鸟以超过 3 马赫的飞行速度而闻名，但 Yeilding 解释说，黑鸟的飞行手册并未显示超过 3.3 马赫的运行速度。 “我们的飞行手册没有提到超过 3.3 马赫的速度，”他回忆道。在考虑有关 SR-71 的极限速度及其飞行员操作极限的说法时，这种区别非常重要。

Yeilding 还回应了有关 SR-71 可以达到 3.4 马赫或更高速度的报道，包括其极限速度为 3.55 马赫的说法。他对已故飞行员大卫·彼得斯表示敬意，并表示“毫无疑问，他在极冷的地区飞行速度超过 3.4 马赫”。然而，Yeilding 从未听说过 3.55 马赫的限制，并联系了经验丰富的 SR-71 飞行员和试飞员学校毕业生 BC Thomas，后者也不知道飞机能够达到这样的速度。 Yeilding 自己在 1990 年创纪录飞行中的经验表明，尽管燃油消耗仍然是一个认真考虑的因素，但在巡航状态下可以达到 3.3 马赫的速度。机组人员无法在整个航线上保持最高速度，而不冒着着陆燃料不足的风险。

title_en: Singapore Airlines Launches New 16-Hour Route Today: See Map Now

summary: The Singaporean carrier is returning to a European capital it last served in 2004.
summary_zh: 这家新加坡航空公司将于 2004 年返回欧洲首都。
body_en: Singapore Airlines Launches New 16-Hour Route Today: See Map Now

Luke has over a decade of experience as a travel writer and aviation analyst. As a passionate traveler based across the Middle East and Asia, Luke offers strong insights into the industry. Based in South East Asia.

Singapore Airlines is set to launch its first flight to Madrid today, October 26, more than two decades after last serving the Spanish capital. Flight SQ388 is scheduled to leave Singapore Changi Airport (SIN) at 11:30 PM local time and arrive at Madrid Barajas Airport (MAD) at 8:50 AM on Tuesday, after a one-hour stop at Barcelona-El Prat Airport (BCN).

The Star Alliance carrier will operate the route five times a week with its Airbus A350-900 fleet, with the outbound journey to Madrid taking 16 hours and 20 minutes. The city becomes Singapore Airlines' 15th European destination and its second in Spain. The airline last served the city in October 2004, when its Boeing 747-400s flew to Madrid after a stop at Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG).
Singapore Airlines Returns To Madrid After 22 Years

The new service is an extension of Singapore Airlines' existing Barcelona flights. Flight SQ388 is blocked at 14 hours and 10 minutes to reach Barcelona from Singapore, followed by one hour on the ground and a further 70 minutes of flying to Madrid.

This outbound service will be a late-night departure from Singapore, scheduled to leave at 11:30 PM local time. It will get passengers into Spain by the morning, ultimately arriving in Madrid at 8:50 AM.

The return journey, SQ387 , turns around in just over an hour, leaving Madrid at 10:00 AM. It will spend 80 minutes on the ground in Barcelona before beginning its 12-hour-and-50-minute journey to Singapore Changi. The total journey time from Madrid to Singapore will be 15 hours and 25 minutes, almost an hour shorter than the outbound service.

The carrier will use the long-haul version of its A350-900, which offers 253 seats across three cabins — 42 in Business Class, 24 in Premium Economy and 187 in Economy. The flight will run five times per week on the following schedule (all times local)

Singapore will not sell tickets solely for the leg between Barcelona and Madrid. The five weekly flights replace the two weekly nonstop flights Singapore previously operated to Barcelona, as well as the three-times-weekly Singapore-Milan-Barcelona service that ends on October 27.

The Singaporean airline joins several Asian carriers already flying to Madrid, including Air China, Beijing Capital Airlines, Cathay Pacific, China Eastern Airlines, China Southern Airlines, Hainan Airlines, Korean Air, Sichuan Airlines and Uzbekistan Airways.

The Singaporean carrier last flew to Madrid over two decades ago, ending its 12-year presence in the Spanish capital in 2004. The carrier first launched flights in April 1992, using Boeing 747-300s that flew via Paris or Amsterdam, according to Mainly Miles . The route was later upgraded to the Boeing 747-400, with all flights connecting via Paris, before it dropped Madrid from its network in October 2004.

Since then, Singapore passengers have relied on codeshare connections with Star Alliance partners such as Lufthansa and Swiss to reach Madrid. Connections via Munich Airport (MUC) can take close to 18 hours, involving several hours of waiting at the connection airport.
Emergency squawks, holds, NOTAMs — live signals, no signup.

Meanwhile, Barcelona has been part of the airline's network for more than two decades. The carrier began serving the city in July 2006, with three weekly flights via a stop in Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP). It then began nonstop services to Barcelona in March 2011, when the city became a stop on its first-ever South American route to São Paulo Guarulhos (GRU), but ended this route in 2016. It would later resume nonstop flights from Singapore to Barcelona in June 2024.

body_zh: 新加坡航空今日推出新的 16 小时航线：立即查看地图
卢克拥有十多年的旅行作家和航空分析师经验。作为一名遍及中东和亚洲的热情旅行者，卢克对该行业提供了深刻的见解。总部位于东南亚。
新加坡航空将于今天（10 月 26 日）开通首个飞往马德里的航班，距离上次飞往西班牙首都的航班已有二十多年了。 SQ388 航班定于当地时间晚上 11:30 从新加坡樟宜机场 (SIN) 起飞，在巴塞罗那埃尔普拉特机场 (BCN) 停留一小时后，于周二上午 8:50 抵达马德里巴拉哈斯机场 (MAD)。
这家星空联盟航空公司将使用其空客 A350-900 机队每周执飞该航线 5 班，前往马德里的出境旅程需要 16 小时 20 分钟。该城市成为新加坡航空在欧洲的第 15 个目的地，也是在西班牙的第二个目的地。该航空公司最后一次为该市提供服务是在 2004 年 10 月，当时其波音 747-400 飞机经停巴黎戴高乐机场 (CDG) 后飞往马德里。
新加坡航空时隔 22 年后重返马德里
这项新服务是新加坡航空现有巴塞罗那航班的延伸。 SQ388 航班从新加坡飞往巴塞罗那的航班在 14 小时 10 分钟后受阻，随后在地面停留 1 小时，再飞 70 分钟飞往马德里。
此去程航班将从新加坡深夜出发，计划于当地时间晚上 11:30 出发。乘客将于早上抵达西班牙，最终于上午 8:50 抵达马德里。
回程航班 SQ387 仅需一个多小时，将于上午 10:00 从马德里出发。它将在巴塞罗那地面停留 80 分钟，然后开始 12 小时 50 分钟的旅程前往新加坡樟宜。从马德里到新加坡的总行程时间为15小时25分钟，比出境航班缩短了近一个小时。
该航空公司将使用 A350-900 的长途版本，该机型在三个客舱内提供 253 个座位：42 个商务舱座位、24 个豪华经济舱座位和 187 个经济舱座位。该航班每周运行五班，时间表如下（所有时间均为当地时间）
新加坡不会仅出售巴塞罗那和马德里之间航线的机票。每周 5 趟航班取代了新加坡此前每周运营 2 趟飞往巴塞罗那的直达航班，以及将于 10 月 27 日结束的每周 3 趟新加坡-米兰-巴塞罗那航班。
这家新加坡航空公司加入了已经飞往马德里的多家亚洲航空公司的行列，包括中国国际航空、北京首都航空、国泰航空、中国东方航空、中国南方航空、海南航空、大韩航空、四川航空和乌兹别克斯坦航空。
这家新加坡航空公司上一次飞往马德里的航班是在二十多年前，于 2004 年结束了在西班牙首都 12 年的运营。 据 Mainly Miles 报道，该航空公司于 1992 年 4 月首次开通航班，使用的是经巴黎或阿姆斯​​特丹飞往马德里的波音 747-300。该航线后来升级为波音 747-400，所有航班均经巴黎转机，随后于 2004 年 10 月从马德里航线网络中删除。
从那时起，新加坡乘客就依靠与汉莎航空和瑞士航空等星空联盟合作伙伴的代码共享航班抵达马德里。通过慕尼黑机场 (MUC) 转机可能需要近 18 小时，其中需要在转机机场等待几个小时。

与此同时，巴塞罗那已成为该航空公司网络的一部分已有二十多年了。该航空公司于 2006 年 7 月开始为该市提供服务，每周有 3 个航班经停米兰马尔彭萨机场 (MXP)。随后，该公司于 2011 年 3 月开始开通飞往巴塞罗那的直飞航班，该城市成为其首条飞往圣保罗瓜鲁柳斯 (GRU) 的南美航线的一站，但于 2016 年终止了该航线。随后于 2024 年 6 月恢复从新加坡飞往巴塞罗那的直飞航班。

title_en: Brussels Airport to expand border controls as EES delays persist, government registration kiosks remain offline
title_zh: 由于EES持续延误，布鲁塞尔机场扩大边境管制，政府登记亭仍处于离线状态
summary: Brussels Airport will add eight manual border-control positions for arriving passengers by the end of 2026 and install six additional electronic gates in early 2027, as long waiting times linked to the European Entry/Exit System (EES) continue to disrupt passe
summary_zh: 布鲁塞尔机场将于 2026 年底前为抵达旅客增设 8 个手动边境管制站，并增设 6 个电子登机口
body_en: Brussels Airport to expand border controls as EES delays persist, government registration kiosks remain offline - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Brussels Airport (BRU) Brussels Airport to expand border controls as EES delays persist, government registration...

Brussels Airport will add eight manual border-control positions for arriving passengers by the end of 2026 and install six additional electronic gates in early 2027, as long waiting times linked to the European Entry/Exit System (EES) continue to disrupt passenger flows. The latest investment comes despite an earlier expansion of border-control infrastructure, with the airport saying that processing times under the new system remain significantly longer than anticipated. Brussels Airport is also pointing to unresolved technical problems affecting government-supplied registration equipment and calling for further action by European authorities.

The EES introduces digital registration of non-EU nationals travelling into and out of the Schengen Area, including the collection of facial images and fingerprints. According to Brussels Airport, the additional procedures have substantially increased the time required to process arriving passengers. During morning peak periods, the average processing time for each arriving visa passenger is now two to three times longer than before the system’s introduction. The airport says this has resulted in long queues at border control, with waiting times of two to four hours regularly reported at airports across Europe. After a slight improvement in August, waiting times at Brussels Airport increased again in September as biometric registration activity rose.

The airport had already increased the number of manual border-control positions by 20 per cent at arrivals and 25 per cent at departures during 2025, ahead of the EES rollout. These increases exceeded passenger traffic growth, but have proved insufficient to offset the longer processing times. The eight additional positions planned for December will increase arrival border-control capacity by 66 per cent, according to the airport. This means manual capacity at arrivals will have doubled within 12 months. The airport says the new positions must still be brought into operation in consultation with the authorities and other partners involved.

A further six electronic gates, ordered from the Federal Police in May 2026 and scheduled for delivery in early 2027, are expected to increase e-gate capacity at arrivals by 50 per cent. However, access to automated border checks remains restricted for some non-European travellers. Certain nationalities that could previously use e-gates are no longer eligible to do so under the new procedures, while other passengers must first complete EES registration.
Government registration technology still not operational

One of the more significant problems highlighted by Brussels Airport concerns 60 pre-registration kiosks purchased last year to help travellers complete EES registration before reaching a manual border-control desk. The kiosks were intended to reduce the workload at staffed counters and allow eligible non-EU nationals to use electronic gates.

Although the competent authorities decided before the summer that travellers from certain non-European countries could use the system, Brussels Airport says technical problems involving government suppliers mean the kiosks are still not operational. The airport expects the technology to help reduce queues, particularly for departing passengers, once it becomes available. On arrival, however, access to e-gates remains limited to certain nationalities and travellers already registered in the EES.

Brussels Airport is also calling for improvements to the implementation of the EES at European level, backing demands from Airports Council International Europe (ACI Europe) and Airlines for Europe. Proposed measures include optimising biometric checks and introducing a widely available application through which travellers could register in advance. Brussels Airport says only Sweden and Portugal currently offer such an application, and that a suitable solution should also be available in Belgium.

The airport further argues that authorities should retain sufficient flexibility to respond when queues become excessive. One measure it supports is the temporary suspension of biometric registration during periods of severe congestion, while maintaining the necessary security checks.

The expansion plans underline the operational challenge facing Brussels Airport as the EES becomes part of routine border processing. While additional counters and electronic gates should increase capacity, the airport’s own assessment indicates that infrastructure alone will not resolve the problem. The timely introduction of the delayed registration technology, wider access to automated checks and changes to the system’s implementation will also be necessary if waiting times are to return to acceptable levels.

Brussels Airport says it is working with the relevant authorities and government departments through a dedicated steering group, with the stated objective of maintaining secure and accurate border checks while reducing delays for passengers.

首页 机场 布鲁塞尔机场 (BRU) 布鲁塞尔机场将扩大边境管制，因为 EES 持续延误、政府登记...
布鲁塞尔机场将在 2026 年底前为抵达旅客增加 8 个手动边境管制站，并在 2027 年初安装 6 个额外的电子登机口，因为与欧洲出入境系统 (EES) 相关的漫长等待时间继续扰乱客流。尽管早些时候扩大了边境管制基础设施，但最新的投资还是出现了，机场表示新系统下的处理时间仍然比预期长得多。布鲁塞尔机场还指出，尚未解决的技术问题影响了政府提供的登记设备，并呼吁欧洲当局采取进一步行动。
EES 引入了对进出申根区的非欧盟国民进行数字登记，包括收集面部图像和指纹。据布鲁塞尔机场称，额外的程序大大增加了处理抵达乘客所需的时间。在早高峰期间，每位入境签证旅客的平均处理时间比该系统推出前长了两到三倍。机场表示，这导致边境管制处排起长队，欧洲各地机场的等待时间经常长达两到四个小时。继 8 月份略有改善后，随着生物识别登记活动的增加，布鲁塞尔机场的等待时间在 9 月份再次增加。
在 EES 推出之前，机场已于 2025 年将抵达时的手动边境管制位置数量增加了 20%，出发时的手动边境管制位置数量增加了 25%。这些增长超过了客运量的增长，但事实证明不足以抵消更长的处理时间。据机场称，计划于 12 月增设 8 个职位，将使入境边境管制能力增加 66%。这意味着到达站的人工运力将在 12 个月内增加一倍。机场表示，新职位的投入运营仍须与当局和其他相关合作伙伴协商。
联邦警察于 2026 年 5 月订购了另外 6 个电子登机口，计划于 2027 年初交付，预计将使电子登机口的入境容量增加 50%。然而，对于一些非欧洲旅客来说，进行自动边境检查仍然受到限制。根据新程序，以前可以使用电子登机口的某些国籍的乘客不再有资格使用，而其他乘客必须首先完成 EES 注册。
政府登记技术仍未投入使用
布鲁塞尔机场强调的更重要的问题之一涉及去年购买的 60 个预登记亭，以帮助旅客在到达手动边境管制柜台之前完成 EES 登记。这些信息亭的目的是减少柜台的工作量，并允许符合条件的非欧盟国民使用电子门。
尽管主管部门在今年夏天之前决定允许来自某些非欧洲国家的旅客使用该系统，但布鲁塞尔机场表示，涉及政府供应商的技术问题意味着这些自助值机亭仍无法运行。机场预计，一旦这项技术投入使用，将有助于减少排队现象，特别是对于离境旅客而言。然而，抵达后，电子登机口的使用仍然仅限于某些国籍和已在 EES 中注册的旅客。
布鲁塞尔机场还呼吁在欧洲层面改进 EES 的实施，支持欧洲国际机场理事会 (ACI Europe) 和欧洲航空公司的要求。拟议的措施包括优化生物识别检查并引入广泛使用的应用程序，旅客可以通过该应用程序提前登记。布鲁塞尔机场表示，目前只有瑞典和葡萄牙提供此类应用程序，比利时也应该有合适的解决方案。
机场进一步辩称，当局应保留足够的灵活性，以便在排队人数过多时做出反应。它支持的一项措施是在严重拥堵期间暂时停止生物识别注册，同时保持必要的安全检查。
随着 EES 成为常规边境处理的一部分，扩建计划凸显了布鲁塞尔机场面临的运营挑战。虽然额外的柜台和电子门应该会增加容量，但机场自己的评估表明，仅靠基础设施并不能解决问题。如果等待时间要恢复到可接受的水平，还需要及时引入延迟注册技术、更广泛地使用自动检查以及对系统实施进行更改。
布鲁塞尔机场表示，它正在通过一个专门的指导小组与有关当局和政府部门合作，其既定目标是维持安全和准确的边境检查，同时减少乘客的延误。

title_en: Buy Hilton Honors Points With Best-Ever 120% Bonus (0.45 Cents Each): Worth It?
title_zh: 购买希尔顿荣誉客会积分可享史上最佳 120% 奖励（每点 0.45 美分）：值得吗？
summary: Hilton Honors just rolled out its best-ever points purchase bonus: up to 120%, bringing the cost down to 0.45 cents per point.
summary_zh: 希尔顿荣誉客会 (Hilton Honors) 刚刚推出了有史以来最好的积分购买奖励：高达 120%，将成本降至每积分 0.45 美分。
body_en: Hilton Honors is currently offering a promotional bonus on purchased points , which is actually the program’s best-ever offer on purchasing points! While Hilton Honors ordinarily offers up to a 100% bonus on purchased points, this time around the program is offering up to a 120% bonus, which is a cost of 0.45 cents per point. This could represent a great value for hotel redemptions, especially with an immediate use in mind.

However, let me state that I find Hilton points purchase promotions broadly to be a lot less lucrative than in the past, given that Hilton Honors underwent a massive devaluation , and within the past year or so, top properties have gone up in price by up to 67%. So only take advantage of this if you know what you’re doing, and are aware of the program’s latest pricing.
Link: Buy Hilton Honors points with this promotion with a 120% bonus

Between 12AM ET on October 7 and 11:59PM ET on November 21, 2026, Hilton Honors is offering a bonus on purchased points . Different members may be targeted for different bonuses, so you’ll want to log into your account to see what you’re eligible for. It would appear that the best offer is for up to a 120% bonus, and that’s structured as follows
Buy 5,000-240,000 points, receive a 120% bonus

Hilton Honors ordinarily charges one cent per purchased point, including all taxes and fees. That’s before any discounts or bonuses. If you’re eligible for the 120% bonus and maxed out the offer, you’d receive a total of 528,000 points at a cost of $2,400, which is a rate of 0.45 cents per Hilton Honors point.

Ordinarily, Hilton Honors lets members buy up to 160,000 points per account per calendar year, before any bonuses. However, during this promotion, that cap has been increased by 50%, to 240,000 points. With a 120% bonus, that means you could purchase up to 528,000 points.

The purchase of Hilton Honors points is non-refundable, and points purchased don’t count toward elite status. Purchased points will post within 48 hours of finalizing the purchase (though in my experience, much faster than that).
Does Hilton let you share or combine points with others?
While Hilton Honors has a strict limit on how many points you can buy, note that there are ways to acquire more points than that limit without violating the rules.

Hilton lets members combine points across accounts at no cost , so in reality you could acquire substantially more points by simply buying them across accounts and then consolidating them. Hilton Honors lets members transfer up to 500,000 points, and receive up to two million points, per calendar year. Each member can make up to six transfers to other members per calendar year, and new Hilton Honors members can only transfer or receive points a minimum of 30 days after enrollment.
Hilton also allows points pooling, whereby Hilton Honors members can combine points with up to 10 other members, with the same limitations.
How does this compare to other Hilton buy points promotions?

When Hilton Honors offer a promotion on purchased points, it’s most common to see a 100% bonus (the equivalent of a 50% bonus). So this 120% bonus is the best-ever promotion we’ve seen from the program, so that’s awesome.
Below is a chart with some of the recent buy points promotions we saw from the Hilton Honors program, before this one.

Buy points offer Start date End date Cost per point 100% bonus August 5, 2026 September 25, 2026 0.5 cents 100% bonus June 10, 2026 July 24, 2026 0.5 cents 100% bonus April 8, 2026 May 29, 2026 0.5 cents 100% bonus January 28, 2026 March 14, 2026 0.5 cents Which credit card should you buy Hilton points with?

Hilton Honors point purchases are processed by points.com, meaning they don’t count as a hotel purchase for the purposes of credit card spending. That means if you pay with a Hilton credit card, you wouldn’t earn any bonus rewards, so it’s not treated as if it’s Hilton spending.

I’d recommend using a card with which you’re trying to reach a minimum spending requirement , or a credit card that maximizes your return on everyday spending . When in doubt, review which credit cards are best for buying points and miles .

There’s potentially huge value to be had buying Hilton Honors points . Hilton Honors sells points at a reasonable cost, has lots of aspirational properties, has good redemptions with a fifth night free opportunity, and elite status is also easy to earn with the program. Hilton’s partnership with Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH) is also awesome, and offers great redemption opportunities .

However, people shouldn’t blindly buy Hilton Honors points, as there are also lots of redemptions where you won’t come out ahead. As I see it, the biggest value with buying Hilton Honors is for aspirational redemptions at expensive properties. Let me give some examples, based on current redemption rates.

body_en: Air France Cancels All Flights To 7 International Destinations: See Full List Now

James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

For obvious reasons, Air France is France's largest operator. OAG data shows that the SkyTeam member has 24% of the nation's flights in 2026. Its share jumps to 37% for total Paris activity and 58% at its Paris Charles De Gaulle Airport (CDG) hub.

Air France at CDG is the third-largest European hub for flights this year, after Turkish Airlines at Istanbul Airport (its hub is on the European side of the Bosphorus Strait) and sibling KLM at Amsterdam. British Airways at London Heathrow is fourth and Lufthansa at Frankfurt is fifth. As always, other measurements will yield different results.
Air France Has Stopped Flying To These Destinations

Schedule analysis indicates that the SkyTeam carrier has eliminated all flights to these seven airports. The list was identified by comparing the airline's network between January 2026 and October 2026 with what is planned from November 2026 onward . It is the latest examination of the changing networks of European carriers. Others include easyJet , Lufthansa , Ryanair , and Wizz Air .

None of the following places have flights bookable in the future, although things could change. For example, Air France ceased flying to Cuba given the country's fuel shortage, blackouts, and wider problems. It is thus possible that it'll return at some point. Multiple airlines from other countries have stopped flying there, including Air Canada and WestJet .
Stuttgart (partly because of high-speed trains)

Bangui is the capital of the Central African Republic, and was part of Air France's network for many years. The elimination of that market was influenced by several factors, including insufficient yields, the high fuel price, the inability to fly over Niger (which extended flights and made them even more costly), and Air France's partnerships with Afrijet and FlyGabon.

In September, the French flag carrier revealed that it would end all flights to Denver International Airport (DEN). This is largely because United Airlines will introduce service from its DEN hub to CDG next year . Air France is the third European carrier to cease DEN flights recently, joining Edelweiss in 2025 and Aer Lingus in 2026 .

Air France arrived in DEN in 2021. It was the second airline to attempt to make CDG-DEN service work, following Norwegian's experiment which existed in 2018 and 2019. Air France's approach to the market was changeable . This involved various things, including whether flights were year-round or seasonal, the frequency, and the equipment.

While not a ringing endorsement of the route, it was in an attempt to find out what works best. In the end, the carrier decided on having fewer flights, lower overall capacity, a shorter operating period, along with more economy-heavy equipment. And then United announced flights, and Air France elected not to continue. Given the many changes when it was the sole operator, it'd be surprising if it did.
Only Two Places Have Been Added To Air France's Map (For Now)

From November 2026 through next summer, only two new destinations have thus far been revealed. On May 14, 2027, the carrier will lift off from CDG to Nashville International Airport (BNA), with three weekly flights on the A350-900 . Air France will be the fourth operator between Europe and BNA, joining Aer Lingus, British Airways, and Icelandair.

While Air France has had flights to San Diego International Airport (SAN) on various occasions, they have always been for major conferences, such as the American Society of Hematology. A normal operation has not been available, but that is now changing. Regular service will begin on May 17, with three weekly flights on the A350-900. As with BNA, four European airlines will now serve SAN, with Air France coexisting with BA, KLM, and Lufthansa.

詹姆斯与路线开发息息相关。詹姆斯曾就读于拉夫堡大学和克兰菲尔德大学航空运输管理专业，拥有航空公司战略和经济学博士学位。 James 曾任伦敦卢顿机场市场机会分析师和 anna.aero 首席分析师。他向本科生和研究生教授航空公司战略和经济学五年，并与多家航空公司在航线和市场情报项目上密切合作。他居住在英国伦敦附近。

9 月，这家法国旗舰航空公司透露将停止飞往丹佛国际机场 (DEN) 的所有航班。这主要是因为联合航空将于明年推出从其 DEN 枢纽飞往戴高乐机场的服务。法航是最近第三家停止 DEN 航班的欧洲航空公司，继 2025 年雪绒花航空和 2026 年爱尔兰航空之后。

虽然法航曾在各种场合有飞往圣地亚哥国际机场 (SAN) 的航班，但它们始终是参加大型会议，例如美国血液学会。正常操作尚不可用，但现在正在改变。常规服务将于 5 月 17 日开始，每周由 A350-900 执飞 3 趟航班。与 BNA 一样，四家欧洲航空公司现在将提供 SAN 服务，其中法航与 BA、KLM 和汉莎航空共存。

title_en: How Much Money Do Boeing 777X Test Pilots Earn In 2026?
title_zh: 2026 年波音 777X 试飞员能赚多少钱？
summary: Unlike traditional airline pilots, Boeing's flight-test crews are tasked with pushing an unfinished aircraft into extreme operating conditions.
summary_zh: 与传统航空公司飞行员不同，波音公司的飞行测试人员的任务是将未完工的飞机推入极端的操作条件。
body_en: How Much Money Do Boeing 777X Test Pilots Earn In 2026?

Josh is an avgeek and pilot based in the United Kingdom. He started at Simple Flying as a Commercial Aviation Journalist before taking a less writing-focused role as Content & Growth Lead for Simple Flying's Flight Tracker.

The flight test crew guiding the Boeing 777X through its lengthy certification campaign occupies one of the most demanding jobs in commercial aviation. Unlike traditional airline pilots, Boeing’s flight-test crews are tasked with pushing an unfinished aircraft into extreme operating conditions, evaluating everything from flight-control software to emergency handling characteristics before the aircraft is put into final production and is cleared to carry passengers.

That level of responsibility comes with significant pay. In 2026, Boeing test pilots connected to the 777X program are estimated to earn between roughly $100,000 (€88,000) and more than $250,000 (€220,000) annually, depending on seniority, technical qualifications, military testing experience, and involvement in FAA certification work. While Boeing does not publish a dedicated “777X test pilot” salary category, compensation data from Boeing employees and the wider aircraft test pilot market provide a clear picture of what these highly specialized aviators can earn. Join us as we explore the world of test pilots, their roles and responsibilities, as well as how their remuneration stacks up against their mainline colleagues.
Boeing Test Pilots Earn Well Into Six Figures

Boeing’s internal salary data suggests test pilots are among the company’s highest-paid aviation professionals. Reported compensation figures place the average Boeing test pilot salary at around $136,000 (€120,000) annually, while flight test pilots specifically average roughly $126,000 (€111,000) in base pay before bonuses and any other additional compensation they may accumulate.

The highest-paid personnel earn considerably more. Senior experimental pilots and certification specialists working on advanced aircraft programs can reportedly exceed $230,000 (€202,000) annually, with some compensation estimates approaching $270,000 (€237,000) for top-tier professionals. Those upper-level salaries typically apply to pilots with decades of experience in military aviation, aircraft engineering, or complex certification testing.

Unlike airline pilots, Boeing test pilots are deeply involved in the technical side of aircraft development. Their responsibilities often include designing test profiles, evaluating aircraft performance data, analyzing system behavior, and coordinating directly with engineers and regulators during certification campaigns. On the 777X program, pilots may spend weeks preparing for highly specific certification flights focused on areas such as flight-control responses, engine performance, and emergency handling. They are also expected to provide detailed technical feedback to Boeing engineers and FAA officials after each test mission, making them a critical part of the aircraft’s development process.
The 777X Certification Campaign Raises The Stakes

The 777X remains one of the most closely watched commercial aircraft programs in the aerospace industry. Originally expected to enter service years earlier, the aircraft has faced repeated certification delays tied to technical challenges, changing regulatory standards, and increased FAA oversight following broader scrutiny of Boeing’s certification practices. By 2026, the 777X program had accumulated billions of dollars in additional development costs as Boeing continued working toward final regulatory approval.

A major milestone arrived in March 2026 when the FAA cleared the 777-9 to begin Phase 4A certification testing. This is one of the final and most in-depth stages of regulatory certification. It involves transitioning from evaluating isolated systems to testing the aircraft as a completed, operational platform. The testing focuses heavily on validating flight-control laws, redundancy protection, cockpit systems, and aircraft response during abnormal or high-stress scenarios that could occur during airline operations.

The workload required to complete certification remains enormous. Boeing still needs thousands of additional flight-test hours to satisfy FAA documentation and performance requirements, with several test aircraft often flying simultaneously during the campaign. Every flight generates large volumes of technical data that must be reviewed by engineers, pilots, and regulators before the aircraft can move closer to commercial approval. The scale and complexity of that process help explain why experienced flight-test pilots remain among the highest-paid specialists in aviation.
The Wider Aircraft Test Pilot Market Also Pays Strongly

Boeing salaries generally align with broader trends across the aircraft testing industry. In 2026, experienced aircraft test pilots with advanced planning and evaluation skills reportedly average around $164,000 (€144,000) annually, while top earners approach or exceed $200,000 (€176,000) per year. Compensation can climb even higher for pilots involved in next-generation commercial aircraft certification programs, particularly those requiring extensive coordination with regulators and engineering teams.

A380 747 787 A350 777 737 MAX A320neo More types

Other compensation estimates place the national average closer to $129,000 (€113,000) annually, though that figure includes a much wider range of aviation testing roles across government agencies, aerospace contractors, and private manufacturers. Entry-level or developmental testing positions tend to fall well below the salaries earned by senior experimental pilots working on advanced aircraft programs such as the Boeing 777X.

Pilots working on flagship programs like the 777X usually sit near the top of the profession. Many possess backgrounds in military experimental testing, engineering qualifications, and years of experience operating high-performance aircraft in demanding environments. Those credentials are relatively rare, allowing senior certification pilots to earn substantially more than standard aviation professionals while also placing them among the most technically skilled pilots in commercial aerospace.
Airline Widebody Captains Can Still Earn More

Although Boeing test pilots earn impressive salaries, senior airline captains at major global carriers can sometimes make even more . Experienced captains flying aircraft such as the Boeing 777 or Airbus A350 for major international airlines frequently earn between $250,000 (€220,000) and $450,000 (€396,000) annually, including bonuses, profit sharing, retirement contributions, and seniority-based pay incentives. Those figures have climbed sharply in recent years as airlines compete for experienced long-haul pilots amid ongoing pilot shortages and strong international travel demand.
body_zh: 2026 年波音 777X 试飞员能赚多少钱？
乔什是一位来自英国的普通极客和飞行员。他最初在 Simple Flying 担任商业航空记者，后来担任 Simple Flying 的 Flight Tracker 的内容和增长主管，担任不太注重写作的角色。
指导波音 777X 通过漫长的认证活动的飞行测试人员是商业航空领域要求最高的工作之一。与传统航空公司飞行员不同，波音公司的飞行测试人员的任务是将未完工的飞机推入极端操作条件，在飞机投入最终生产并获准载客之前评估从飞行控制软件到紧急处理特性的所有内容。

这种程度的责任伴随着丰厚的报酬。到 2026 年，参与 777X 项目的波音试飞员预计年收入约为 100,000 美元（88,000 欧元）至超过 250,000 美元（220,000 欧元），具体取决于资历、技术资格、军事测试经验以及参与 FAA 认证工作的情况。虽然波音没有公布专门的“777X 试飞员”薪资类别，但来自波音员工和更广泛的飞机试飞员市场的薪酬数据清楚地显示了这些高度专业化的飞行员的收入。加入我们，探索试飞员的世界、他们的角色和责任，以及他们的薪酬与主线同事相比如何。
波音试飞员的收入高达六位数
波音公司的内部薪资数据显示，试飞员是该公司薪资最高的航空专业人员之一。报道的薪酬数据显示，波音试飞员的平均年薪约为 136,000 美元（120,000 欧元），而飞行试飞员的平均基本工资约为 126,000 美元（111,000 欧元），不包括奖金和他们可能积累的任何其他额外报酬。
收入最高的人员收入要高得多。据报道，从事先进飞机项目的高级实验飞行员和认证专家每年的收入可超过 230,000 美元（202,000 欧元），顶级专业人士的一些薪酬估计接近 270,000 美元（237,000 欧元）。这些高薪通常适用于在军用航空、飞机工程或复杂认证测试方面拥有数十年经验的飞行员。

与航空公司飞行员不同，波音试飞员深入参与飞机开发的技术方面。他们的职责通常包括设计测试配置文件、评估飞机性能数据、分析系统行为以及在认证活动期间直接与工程师和监管机构协调。在 777X 计划中，飞行员可能会花费数周时间为高度具体的认证飞行做准备，重点关注飞行控制响应、发动机性能和紧急处理等领域。他们还预计在每次测试任务后向波音工程师和美国联邦航空局官员提供详细的技术反馈，使他们成为飞机开发过程的关键部分。
777X 认证活动提高了风险
777X 仍然是航空航天业最受关注的商用飞机项目之一。最初预计该飞机将在几年前投入使用，但由于技术挑战、监管标准的变化以及在对波音认证实践进行更广泛审查后美国联邦航空局加强监管，认证一再延迟。到 2026 年，随着波音继续争取最终监管批准，777X 项目已积累了数十亿美元的额外开发成本。
2026 年 3 月，一个重要的里程碑到来，美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 批准 777-9 开始 4A 阶段认证测试。这是监管认证的最后也是最深入的阶段之一。它涉及从评估孤立系统过渡到将飞机作为一个完整的操作平台进行测试。测试的重点是验证飞行控制法、冗余保护、驾驶舱系统以及飞机在航空公司运营期间可能发生的异常或高压力情况下的响应。
完成认证所需的工作量仍然巨大。波音公司仍需要数千小时的额外飞行测试来满足美国联邦航空局的文件和性能要求，在测试期间，几架测试飞机经常同时飞行。每次飞行都会产生大量技术数据，这些数据必须经过工程师、飞行员和监管机构的审查，然后飞机才能更接近商业批准。这一过程的规模和复杂性有助于解释为什么经验丰富的试飞飞行员仍然是航空领域收入最高的专家之一。
更广泛的飞机试飞员市场也带来了丰厚的回报
波音公司的薪资通常与整个飞机测试行业的更广泛趋势一致。据报道，到 2026 年，具有先进规划和评估技能的经验丰富的飞机试飞员的年平均收入约为 164,000 美元（144,000 欧元），而高收入者的年收入将接近或超过 200,000 美元（176,000 欧元）。对于参与下一代商用飞机认证计划的飞行员，尤其是那些需要与监管机构和工程团队广泛协调的飞行员，薪酬可能会更高。
选择一架飞机，看看现在有多少架飞机在空中
其他薪酬估计显示全国平均每年接近 129,000 美元（113,000 欧元），尽管这个数字包括政府机构、航空航天承包商和私营制造商中更广泛的航空测试角色。入门级或开发测试职位往往远低于从事波音 777X 等先进飞机项目的高级实验飞行员的工资。
从事 777X 等旗舰项目的飞行员通常处于行业顶尖水平。许多人拥有军事实验测试背景、工程资格以及在苛刻环境下操作高性能飞机的多年经验。这些证书相对较少，使得高级认证飞行员的收入远远高于标准航空专业人员，同时也使他们跻身商业航空航天领域技术最熟练的飞行员之列。
航空公司宽体机长仍然可以获得更多收入

尽管波音试飞员的薪水令人印象深刻，但全球主要航空公司的高级机长有时可以赚得更多。为主要国际航空公司驾驶波音 777 或空客 A350 等飞机的经验丰富的机长每年的收入通常在 250,000 美元（220,000 欧元）至 450,000 美元（396,000 欧元）之间，包括奖金、利润分享、退休金和基于资历的薪酬激励。近年来，随着飞行员持续短缺和国际旅行需求强劲，航空公司争夺经验丰富的长途飞行员，这些数字急剧攀升。

body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

A Southwest Airlines flight attendant is suing the low-cost carrier for alleged discrimination against her in violation of the Americans with Disabilities Act. Lisa Diane Patterson claims that her employer refused to accommodate her severe allergy, according to the suit filed as 'Patterson v. Southwest Airlines Co.' , as covered by HR Dive.

When scheduled to work a flight with animals present, Patterson says that the carrier only offered the option to go home without pay or endure the flight in the case that no other FA was voluntarily willing to switch shifts. The FA says that this resulted in substantial income loss for her as well as illness when she elected to attempt to work flights with pets present in the cabin.
A Flight Attendant's Plea To The C-Suite Falls On Deaf Ears

Patterson alleged that when she encountered flights with cats or dogs in her working section, Southwest management told her that no accommodation could be made. Patterson claims to have written a letter directly to Southwest's vice president of in-flight operations in 2018, when the company updated its policy to allow only cats and dogs as support animals. In her words, the VP responded about three months later, only to flatly refuse and offer no alternatives.

She attempted to navigate the mandate of the airline with proposals to reseat passengers bringing their pets into a different cabin section from the one where she was working, which was also rejected. Following a series of failed attempts to resolve the matter with management, Patterson demanded a jury trial to pursue damages and other compensation for what she claims to be discriminatory business practices.

The lawsuit notes that because colleagues rarely agreed to switch, she rarely had any option other than to lose a paycheck and suffer through her allergic reaction for the duration of the flight. She has sued the airline on the premise of unlawful employment practices to seek punitive damages. Beyond simply seeking to remedy her own situation, the FA is also pursuing an injunction against the airline to prevent Southwest from repeating the same practices in the future.

The Challenges Of Emotional Support Animals In The Air

The 2018 policy change by Southwest was made under the permissive rules laid out by the Air Carrier Access Act. This guidance legally allows for a wide range of Emotional Support Animals to be brought on board for free as long as they are officially endorsed by a mental health professional. For Southwest's part, the airline limits pets exclusively to cats and dogs, with no other species permitted.

The result has been a challenge for cabin crew and airlines alike to manage the increased complexity of operating safe and clean flights while also accommodating more service animals. Because ESAs do not require formal training like task-oriented service dogs, airlines faced a spike in incidents involving animal aggression, biting, barking, and animals urinating or defecating in the cabin.

In the lawsuit, the flight attendant argues that moving a passenger with a pet to another part of the plane was a minor change. From Southwest’s operational and risk management perspective, the airline likely refused her accommodation requests due to the open seating policy of its previous model, as well as the legal requirements of balancing compliance with competing disability laws.
Managing ADA Compliance While Keeping Americans Moving On Time

Airlines frequently run into the legal concept of competing accommodations. Under the ADA, Southwest is legally obligated to accommodate employees with disabilities. However, under the ACAA, they are also legally required to accommodate passengers traveling with trained service or psychiatric support animals.

Southwest essentially treated the pet policy as an unalterable operational baseline. Their stance was that if an employee could not be in the cabin with cats or dogs, they could not perform the 'essential functions' of being a Southwest flight attendant.

西南航空的一名空乘人员正在起诉这家廉价航空公司，指控其歧视她，违反了《美国残疾人法案》。根据名为“帕特森诉西南航空公司”的诉讼，丽莎·黛安·帕特森声称她的雇主拒绝照顾她的严重过敏症。 ，如 HR Dive 所报道。
帕特森表示，在安排有动物在场的航班时，航空公司只提供了无薪回家或在没有其他 FA 自愿换班的情况下忍受飞行的选择。英足总表示，这给她带来了巨大的收入损失，并且当她选择尝试在机舱内携带宠物的航班时，她还患上了疾病。
一名空乘人员向最高管理层提出的请求被置若罔闻
帕特森声称，当她在工作区域遇到有猫或狗的航班时，西南航空公司的管理层告诉她不能提供住宿。帕特森声称，他在 2018 年直接给西南航空负责机上运营的副总裁写了一封信，当时该公司更新了政策，只允许猫和狗作为支持动物。用她的话说，副总统大约三个月后做出了回应，但只是断然拒绝，并且没有提供任何替代方案。
她试图按照航空公司的要求，提出将携带宠物的乘客重新安排到与她工作的舱室不同的舱段的建议，但该建议也遭到拒绝。在与管理层解决此事的一系列尝试失败后，帕特森要求陪审团进行审判，以就她所称的歧视性商业行为寻求损害赔偿和其他赔偿。
诉讼指出，由于同事很少同意更换，她除了失去薪水并在飞行期间遭受过敏反应之外，几乎别无选择。她以非法雇佣行为为由起诉该航空公司，寻求惩罚性赔偿。除了简单地寻求补救自己的处境外，英足总还正在对该航空公司发出禁令，以防止西南航空今后重复同样的做法。

空中情感支持动物的挑战
西南航空 2018 年的政策变更是根据《航空承运人准入法》规定的许可规则做出的。该指南合法地允许免费携带各种情感支持动物登机，只要它们得到心理健康专业人士的正式认可。就西南航空而言，该航空公司只允许携带猫和狗作为宠物，不允许携带其他物种。
这对机组人员和航空公司来说都是一个挑战，他们需要管理日益复杂的安全和清洁航班，同时还要容纳更多的服务性动物。由于 ESA 不需要像任务型服务犬那样进行正式训练，因此航空公司面临着动物攻击、咬人、吠叫以及动物在机舱内排尿或排便等事件的激增。
在诉讼中，空乘人员辩称，将携带宠物的乘客转移到飞机的其他部分只是一个微小的改变。从西南航空的运营和风险管理角度来看，该航空公司可能拒绝了她的住宿请求，因为其先前机型的开放座位政策，以及平衡遵守竞争性残疾法律的法律要求。
管理 ADA 合规性，同时让美国人准时出行
航空公司经常遇到竞争住宿的法律概念。根据 ADA，西南航空有法律义务为残疾员工提供便利。然而，根据 ACAA，法律还要求它们为携带经过训练的服务动物或精神支持动物旅行的乘客提供住宿。
西南航空本质上将宠物政策视为不可改变的运营基准。他们的立场是，如果员工不能与猫或狗一起呆在机舱内，他们就无法履行西南航空空乘人员的“基本职能”。

title_en: American Airlines Fell From 14.6 To 0.6% Of The JFK–Seattle Market & Is Coming Back On The Airbus A321neo
title_zh: 美国航空在肯尼迪机场-西雅图市场的份额从 14.6% 下降至 0.6%，并凭借空客 A321neo 卷土重来
summary: The airline will relaunch service with two daily flights starting in April 2027.
summary_zh: 该航空公司将从 2027 年 4 月开始重新启动每日两班航班的服务。
body_en: American Airlines Fell From 14.6 To 0.6% Of The JFK–Seattle Market & Is Coming Back On The Airbus A321neo

Jack comes to Simple Flying with a lifelong interest in all things aviation. He holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech, and is a certified private and remote pilot. Beyond these experiences, Jack previously worked for a corporate flight department where he gained first-hand experience in the world of business aviation. Currently, Jack works in the professional services industry and continues to build his flight hours outside of work.

American Airlines will return to the John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) to Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA) market on April 6, 2027, with two daily round-trip flights operated by the Airbus A321neo . The relaunch will restore a nonstop connection that American last operated in 2019, placing it back in a competitive transcontinental market dominated by airlines with established schedules and substantial customer bases. The aircraft will offer 196 seats, including 20 in First Class, but will not feature lie-flat business-class seating or a separate premium-economy cabin.

The comeback is notable because American's share of the nonstop JFK–Seattle market reportedly fell from 14.6% in 2018 to just 0.6% in the 12 months ending June 2026, according to market data cited by aviation publication Deep Arrival . American is also adjusting its wider New York network, moving seasonal Bozeman service from LaGuardia to JFK and increasing that route from one weekly flight to four. Those additions arrive as the airline trims other routes and moderates planned growth for summer 2027. Together, the changes suggest a selective effort to rebuild opportunities at JFK rather than expand capacity indiscriminately.
American Is Rebuilding A Lost Position In A Major Transcontinental Market

American's scheduled return will restore nonstop service between two major metropolitan areas after an absence of nearly eight years. The airline last operated JFK–Seattle until July 2019, according to AeroRoutes , leaving other carriers to serve the market while American's customers increasingly had to consider alternative airports, connecting itineraries, or competitors for a direct flight. The new schedule will give travelers another nonstop option and restore American's ability to compete directly for passengers traveling between New York and the Pacific Northwest.

The reported decline from a 14.6% market share in 2018 to 0.6% in the 12 months ending June 2026 illustrates how thoroughly American's position weakened. The figures refer to its share of the JFK–Seattle market, not American's overall share of passengers at JFK. They also cover different periods, so they shouldn't be treated as a direct measure of the airline's current share of all New York–Seattle travel. Deep Arrival, citing US Department of Transportation data, reports that 691,655 passengers traveled between JFK and Seattle during the latest 12-month period, with nonstop flights accounting for 98.5% of that traffic.

That high proportion of nonstop travel suggests many passengers in this airport pair market value a direct itinerary over a connection through an airline hub. For American, returning with two daily flights provides a more credible presence than a token seasonal operation would. It creates multiple departure options and lets the airline compete for business and leisure travelers whose schedules may not align with a single daily service.

However, restoring service does not guarantee a return to the market share American held in 2018. Customers who shifted to competitors may have accumulated loyalty benefits, preferred departure times, or corporate travel arrangements during the intervening years. American will need to offer a schedule, fare structure, and onboard product that persuade travelers to reconsider their existing choices. The relaunch gives the airline market access again; winning back passengers will depend on how effectively it uses that access.
The A321neo Provides Capacity Without A Premium Long-Haul Cabin

American plans to use the A321neo on the route, with 20 First Class seats alongside Main Cabin Extra and standard economy seating. The configuration is designed to provide a differentiated domestic product without the expense or weight of a dedicated lie-flat business-class cabin. Travelers will have access to a larger premium-economy-style seat within the front cabin and extra-legroom economy options, but the aircraft will not offer international-style business class, a separate Premium Economy cabin, or seatback entertainment screens. Power outlets and USB ports will be available.

This layout reflects a practical choice for a long domestic route. New York–Seattle is a transcontinental journey, but it doesn't match a long-haul international flight, where lie-flat seats and multiple premium cabins can generate substantial revenue. American can deploy a single-aisle aircraft with a meaningful First Class section while retaining a large economy cabin for leisure travelers and price-conscious customers. The A321neo also offers more seats than smaller narrowbodies, allowing the airline to serve the market without committing to a widebody aircraft.

The trade-off is that passengers comparing premium products may find American's offering less attractive than a flight with lie-flat seats, particularly on evening departures or journeys where rest matters. The absence of seatback entertainment may also influence travelers who prefer a built-in screen rather than relying on personal devices. Those limitations don't make the aircraft unsuitable for the route, but they mean American must compete on schedule convenience, pricing, loyalty benefits, and the quality of its First Class service. The A321neo gives American a flexible platform for the relaunch, but the cabin alone is unlikely to restore its former market share.
Two Daily Flights Offer Useful Schedule Choices

The published schedule gives travelers a morning departure from New York and a late-afternoon option. Two daily round trips are commercially more useful than serving the route once a day because they give customers a choice of departure windows. The morning flight from New York suits travelers who want most of the day in Seattle after landing, while the evening departure may appeal to passengers finishing work or connecting from earlier activities in the region. On the return journey, daytime and late-night flights accommodate different trip lengths and preferences.

Corporate travel planners often value flexibility when booking employees across a large network. A second daily frequency can make a route easier to incorporate into a business itinerary and may reduce the pressure to choose a competitor simply because its departure time fits better. For leisure travelers, more options can help coordinate hotel check-ins, event schedules, and onward ground transportation.
body_zh: 美国航空在肯尼迪机场-西雅图市场的份额从 14.6% 下降至 0.6%，并凭借空客 A321neo 卷土重来
杰克 (Jack) 带着对航空一切事物的终生兴趣加入了简单飞行 (Simple Flying)。他拥有佐治亚理工学院的航空航天工程学位，并且是一名经过认证的私人和远程飞行员。除了这些经验之外，杰克还曾在公司飞行部门工作过，在那里他获得了公务航空领域的第一手经验。目前，杰克在专业服务行业工作，并在工作之外继续增加飞行时间。

美国航空将于 2027 年 4 月 6 日返回约翰·肯尼迪国际机场 (JFK) 至西雅图-塔科马国际机场 (SEA) 市场，每天有两趟往返航班，由空客 A321neo 执飞。此次重新启动将恢复美国航空于 2019 年上次运营的直达航班，使其重新进入竞争激烈的跨大陆市场，该市场由拥有固定航班时刻表和大量客户群的航空公司主导。该飞机将提供 196 个座位，其中包括 20 个头等舱座位，但不会配备可平躺的商务舱座位或独立的高级经济舱。

据航空出版物《Deep Arrival》援引的市场数据显示，截至 2026 年 6 月的 12 个月里，美国航空在肯尼迪机场至西雅图直航市场上的份额从 2018 年的 14.6% 下降至仅 0.6%，此次卷土重来引人注目。美国航空还在调整其更广泛的纽约网络，将季节性的博兹曼航班从拉瓜迪亚机场转移到肯尼迪机场，并将该航线从每周一班增加到四班。这些新增航班正值该航空公司削减其他航线并放缓 2027 年夏季计划增长之际。总而言之，这些变化表明有选择性地努力重建肯尼迪机场的机会，而不是不加区别地扩大运力。
美国航空正在重建跨大陆主要市场中失去的地位
美国航空按计划回归，将恢复两个主要大都市区之间中断近八年后的直达服务。根据 AeroRoutes 的数据，该航空公司直到 2019 年 7 月才运营肯尼迪机场 - 西雅图航线，让其他航空公司为市场提供服务，而美国航空的客户越来越多地不得不考虑替代机场、转机行程或竞争对手的直飞航班。新的时刻表将为旅客提供另一种直达选择，并恢复美国航空直接竞争纽约和太平洋西北地区之间乘客的能力。

据报道，截至 2026 年 6 月的 12 个月内，市场份额从 2018 年的 14.6% 下降至 0.6%，这表明美国航空的地位被彻底削弱。这些数字指的是其在肯尼迪机场-西雅图机场的市场份额，而不是美国航空在肯尼迪机场的乘客总数所占的份额。它们还涵盖不同的时期，因此不应将其视为航空公司当前在所有纽约-西雅图旅行中所占份额的直接衡量标准。 Deep Arrival 援引美国交通部的数据称，最近 12 个月期间，有 691,655 名乘客往返于肯尼迪机场和西雅图之间，其中直飞航班占其中的 98.5%。
如此高的直达旅行比例表明，该机场对市场中的许多乘客都看重直接行程，而不是通过航空枢纽转机。对于美国航空来说，每天两趟航班回国比象征性的季节性运营更可靠。它创造了多种出发选择，让航空公司能够争夺商务和休闲旅客，这些旅客的时间表可能与单一的每日服务不一致。
然而，恢复服务并不能保证美国航空能够恢复到 2018 年的市场份额。转向竞争对手的客户可能在接下来的几年中积累了忠诚度福利、首选出发时间或商务旅行安排。美国航空需要提供时间表、票价结构和机上产品，以说服旅客重新考虑他们现有的选择。重新启动让航空公司再次进入市场；赢回乘客将取决于它如何有效地利用这一通道。
A321neo 无需高级长途客舱即可提供运力
美国航空计划在该航线上使用 A321neo，除了主舱额外座位和标准经济舱座位外，还设有 20 个头等舱座位。该配置旨在提供差异化​​的国内产品，而无需专用的平躺式商务舱的费用或重量。旅客将可以在前舱内使用更大的高级经济舱座位和额外腿部空间的经济舱选项，但飞机不会提供国际风格的商务舱、单独的高级经济舱或座椅靠背娱乐屏幕。提供电源插座和 USB 端口。
这种布局体现了国内长途航线的实用选择。纽约-西雅图是一个横贯大陆的旅程，但它无法与长途国际航班相比，在长途国际航班上，平躺式座椅和多个高级客舱可以产生可观的收入。美国航空可以部署具有有意义的头等舱部分的单通道飞机，同时为休闲旅客和对价格敏感的客户保留大型经济舱。 A321neo 还比小型窄体飞机提供更多座位，使该航空公司能够在不致力于宽体飞机的情况下服务市场。

代价是，比较优质产品的乘客可能会发现美国航空提供的服务不如平躺式座椅的航班有吸引力，特别是在晚上出发或休息很重要的旅程中。椅背娱乐设施的缺失也可能会影响那些更喜欢内置屏幕而不是依赖个人设备的旅行者。这些限制并不意味着飞机不适合该航线，但它们意味着美国航空必须在航班便利性、价格、忠诚度福利以及头等舱服务质量方面进行竞争。 A321neo 为美国航空的重新推出提供了灵活的平台，但仅靠机舱不太可能恢复其以前的市场份额。
每日两趟航班提供实用的时刻表选择
公布的时刻表为旅客提供了早上从纽约出发和下午晚些时候出发的选择。每天两次往返比每天一次提供该航线在商业上更有用，因为它们为乘客提供了出发窗口的选择。从纽约出发的早班航班适合落地后想要在西雅图度过大部分时间的旅客，而晚上出发的航班可能会吸引那些在该地区结束工作或从早期活动转机的旅客。在回程中，白天和深夜航班可满足不同的行程长度和偏好。
企业旅行策划者在通过大型网络预订员工时通常重视灵活性。每日第二个班次可以使某条路线更容易纳入商务行程，并且可以减少仅仅因为其出发时间更合适而选择竞争对手的压力。对于休闲旅行者来说，更多选择可以帮助协调酒店入住、活动安排和后续地面交通。

title_en: Cool: Air Serbia Launching Belgrade To Miami Flights As Of May 2027
title_zh: 酷炫：塞尔维亚航空从 2027 年 5 月起开通贝尔格莱德飞往迈阿密的航班
summary: Air Serbia will launch year-round Belgrade to Miami flights on May 20, 2027, operating twice weekly with an Airbus A330-200. It's the airline's fourth North American destination.
summary_zh: 塞尔维亚航空将于 2027 年 5 月 20 日开通贝尔格莱德飞往迈阿密的全年航班，每周运营两班，由空客 A330-200 执飞。这是该航空公司第四次
body_en: Air Serbia will be launching flights to my home airport , also the carrier’s third destination in the United States, and fourth destination in North America. Executives at the airline have been talking about launching this flight for years, so I’m happy to see it become a reality, as more options are always a good thing.
Air Serbia will start flying to Miami with Airbus A330s
As of May 20, 2027, Air Serbia will launch year-round flights between Belgrade (BEG) and Miami (MIA). The 5,475-mile flight will operate twice weekly, with alternating schedules.
On Thursdays, the flight will operate with the following schedule
JU502 Belgrade to Miami departing 1:50PM arriving 7:50PM
JU503 Miami to Belgrade departing 10:30PM arriving 3:00PM (+1 day)
On Sundays, the flight will operate with the following schedule
JU502 Belgrade to Miami departing 11:30AM arriving 5:30PM
JU503 Miami to Belgrade departing 7:00PM arriving 11:30AM (+1 day)

The flight is blocked at 12hr westbound and 10hr30min eastbound. The airline will use an Airbus A330-200 for the route, as the carrier has four of these in its fleet. Air Serbia’s North America destinations otherwise include Chicago (ORD), New York (JFK), and Toronto (YYZ).
My take on Air Serbia adding flights to Miami

Air Serbia executives have been talking about adding flights to Miami for years, and it seems the major constraint was simply the number of planes in the fleet . Air Serbia flying to Miami makes perfect sense
It’s one of the markets in the United States with the strongest year-round transatlantic demand, since summer has strong demand out of Miami, and winter has strong demand to Miami
South Florida has a big Russian population, and Serbia isn’t in the EU, so Air Serbia provides convenient one-stop service for those passengers

Bigger picture, Air Serbia has built up a strong network in the eastern and southern part of Europe, so offers lots of efficient connectivity to places like Albania, Armenia, Croatia, Georgia, Romania, etc.

I’d say the biggest challenge this route will have is that it operates only twice weekly. That might sound counterintuitive, since that seems like a “safe” way to start service. The catch is that since most people use online travel agencies and travel roundtrip on long haul journeys, many people may not even see Air Serbia as an option, unless they happen to be searching the correct days of the week in both directions.

Air Serbia has a pleasant enough onboard product, including in business class , though it’s nothing to get too excited about. In theory, Air Serbia has a partnership with Air Canada, so you can redeem Aeroplan points on the airline . However, nowadays business class award availability can be really tough to come by.

As of May 2027, Air Serbia will be launching twice weekly service between Belgrade and Miami using Airbus A330s. This is a route that executives at the airline have been teasing for years, so it’s cool to finally see it become a reality. This will be Air Serbia’s fourth destination in North America, and I imagine this route will perform reasonably well.
body_zh: 塞尔维亚航空将开通飞往我家乡机场的航班，这也是该航空公司在美国的第三个目的地和北美的第四个目的地。该航空公司的高管多年来一直在谈论推出该航班，所以我很高兴看到它成为现实，因为更多的选择总是一件好事。
塞尔维亚航空将开始使用空客 A330 执飞迈阿密航线
自 2027 年 5 月 20 日起，塞尔维亚航空将开通贝尔格莱德 (BEG) 和迈阿密 (MIA) 之间的全年航班。该航班全长 5,475 英里，每周运营两班，交替运行。
周四，航班将按照以下时刻表运行
JU502 贝尔格莱德 飞往 迈阿密 出发 1:50PM 到达 7:50PM
JU503 迈阿密 飞往 贝尔格莱德 出发 10:30PM 到达 3:00PM（+1 天）
周日，航班将按照以下时刻表运行
JU502 贝尔格莱德 飞往 迈阿密 出发 11:30AM 到达 5:30PM
JU503 迈阿密 飞往 贝尔格莱德 出发时间 7:00PM 到达 11:30AM（+1 天）
该航班在西行 12 小时和东行 10 小时 30 分钟受阻。该航空公司将使用空客 A330-200 执行该航线，因为该航空公司机队中有四架此类飞机。塞尔维亚航空的北美目的地还包括芝加哥 (ORD)、纽约 (JFK) 和多伦多 (YYZ)。
我对塞尔维亚航空增加飞往迈阿密的航班的看法
塞尔维亚航空高管多年来一直在谈论增加飞往迈阿密的航班，但主要的限制因素似乎只是机队中的飞机数量。塞尔维亚航空飞往迈阿密的航班非常有意义
它是美国全年跨大西洋需求最强劲的市场之一，因为夏季对迈阿密的需求强劲，冬季对迈阿密的需求也强劲
南佛罗里达州有大量俄罗斯人口，而塞尔维亚不属于欧盟，因此塞尔维亚航空为这些乘客提供便捷的一站式服务
从更大的角度来看，塞尔维亚航空在欧洲东部和南部建立了强大的网络，因此为阿尔巴尼亚、亚美尼亚、克罗地亚、格鲁吉亚、罗马尼亚等地提供了许多高效的连接。
我想说这条路线面临的最大挑战是它每周只运营两次。这听起来可能违反直觉，因为这似乎是一种“安全”的启动服务方式。问题是，由于大多数人在长途旅行中使用在线旅行社和往返旅行，许多人甚至可能不会将塞尔维亚航空视为一个选择，除非他们碰巧在两个方向上搜索一周中正确的日子。
塞尔维亚航空拥有足够令人愉悦的机上产品，包括商务舱，尽管这没什么值得兴奋的。理论上，塞尔维亚航空与加拿大航空有合作关系，因此您可以在该航空公司兑换 Aeroplan 积分。然而，如今，获得商务舱奖励确实很难。
自 2027 年 5 月起，塞尔维亚航空将开通每周两次的贝尔格莱德和迈阿密之间的航班，使用空客 A330 飞机。这是该航空公司高管多年来一直在嘲笑的一条航线，所以最终看到它成为现实真是太酷了。这将是塞尔维亚航空在北美的第四个目的地，我想这条航线将会表现相当不错。

title_en: The US Air Force Is Pouring 20 Acres Of Concrete At Guam's Andersen AFB But Refuses To Build Shelters
title_zh: 美国空军正在关岛安德森空军基地浇筑 20 英亩混凝土，但拒绝建造避难所
summary: How America is investing in air power over the Pacific.
summary_zh: 美国如何投资太平洋上空的空中力量。
body_en: The US Air Force Is Pouring 20 Acres Of Concrete At Guam's Andersen AFB But Refuses To Build Shelters

Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

As the US military draws down its presence in Europe and the Middle East to 'Pivot to the Pacific,' the United States Air Force is making major investments in infrastructure for greater operational tempo and larger deployments. Andersen Air Force Base (UAM) represents one of the most important sites in the second island chain that supports the entire Indo-Pacific theater.

Andersen is one of the few bases that is host to critical platforms like the Northrop Grumman B-2 Spirit stealth bomber. As such, the USAF is moving forward with a plan to pour 20 acres of concrete that will dramatically expand apron parking. This construction program was originally intended to be part of an expanded joint facility with the Republic of Singapore Air Force, but since they dropped out, the USAF is still pushing ahead.

The reason for the continued push lies in the Air Force's rapidly increasing focus on agile combat employment, which emphasizes flexibility and unpredictability. The USAF wants to move away from using predictable airbases for the same high-value platforms as stealth bombers as it introduces the world's first sixth-generation aircraft, the NG B-21 Raider. Relating back to the construction choices, these planes do not benefit from new shelters significantly compared to the value of simply adding a lot more 'parking spots' at the airfield.

The decision to pour massive open aprons at Andersen Air Force Base, rather than building protective shelters, reflects a fundamental shift in how the Pentagon plans to survive a missile exchange in the Indo-Pacific. In a conflict with China, permanent hangars are liabilities. Modern satellite imagery ensures their exact coordinates are mapped, making them easy targets for long-range ballistic and cruise missiles. Instead of trying to absorb a missile strike with concrete walls, the Air Force is betting on speed and mobility through its ACE operational concept.

Fifth-generation stealth fighters, including Air Force Lockheed Martin F-22 Raptors and F-35 variants from the Air Force, Navy, and Marine Corps, operate on the leading edge. Because their stealth profiles require carrying weapons internally, their magazine depth is limited. Their primary role is to penetrate contested airspace, map enemy radar and missile batteries, and securely data-link those coordinates to the rest of the fleet. The heavy ordnance is carried by non-stealthy or long-range platforms sitting further back.

The Boeing F-15EX Eagle II, which lacks stealth but boasts a 29,500-lb (13,380 kg) payload capacity, acts as a standoff missile truck. It can fire outsized hypersonic weapons at the targets identified by the F-35s. This firepower is augmented by B-52 and next-generation B-21 bombers executing long-range strike sorties out of Andersen's expanded parking slips.

Simultaneously, Navy P-8 Poseidon aircraft utilize the base to sustain continuous maritime patrol loops, securing the sea lines of communication and tracking adversary submarine movements in the Philippine Sea.

Smaller than the B-2 before it, the Raider can fit into a standard fighter shelter . However, the Air Force has chosen not to build these in order to still accommodate larger planes like the upcoming upgrades that will transition the longest-serving bombers to a newly digitalized standard. The Boeing B-52J Stratofortress will serve as a missile truck that supports the stealthy B-21 in the new Hi-Lo Fleet of the Air Force Global Strike Command.

Together, these two platforms will be the core of the new strategic strike force. At the same time, the US Air Force wants to accommodate a wider range of both its own aircraft and joint assets like the Boeing P-8A Poseidon Maritime Patrol aircraft. Based on the 737-800 airliner airframe, the Poseidon is a critical aircraft in the Pacific Theater, serving as the US Navy's primary MPA. It is also flown by other regional allies like Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, South Korea, and even India.

Alongside these front-line combat planes are a host of transports and tankers that frequent the same air bases to support operations that deliver supplies. The Lockheed C-5M Super Galaxy does not need pristine tarmac to land on, but it does have a massive wingspan like the B-52. The Boeing KC-135 Stratotanker, which is based on an airframe similar to the iconic 707, is approaching the end but is still vital. Its successor, the Boeing KC-46A Pegasus, is even bigger, being based on the company's 767 wide-body airframe.

Adding a huge amount of real estate to the airfield at Andersen will make it a far superior staging and launch point for operations into the first island chain. It will also make it an even more valuable rally point for the air bridge between the continental United States and expeditionary forces deployed to the Pacific.

The airfield is getting upgrades to more than just concrete. New fuel storage and refueling infrastructure will expand the capacity of the airfield as well as expedite hot pit refueling operations for higher ops tempo. This complements the more flexible parking on the apron, which is not obstructed by the hard shelters that would otherwise dictate limitations on wingspan and lead to wasted time shuffling planes around. There will also be major upgrades to the stormwater management system to ensure that the facilities can withstand even the heaviest monsoon rains without diminished capacity.

To protect its new investments, the base will be getting an $8 billion enhanced integrated air defense system to protect everything on the ground. The system will create a 360-degree multi-layer defensive shield with 16 different batteries scattered across Guam, according to Arms Control. The defense architecture is designed to intercept threats at different altitudes, ranging from high-altitude ballistic down to low-altitude cruise missiles and drones.

The Air Force is also allocating multimillion-dollar contracts for renovations to secure communications and personnel barracks. The greater concentration of aircraft means more troops and equipment. At the same time, more advanced airframes require more advanced sustainment technology as well as higher security to protect classified equipment and information. These investments will ensure that all the aircraft deployed to Andersen, as well as the service members who operate them, can perform to their highest potential.

body_zh: 美国空军正在关岛安德森空军基地浇筑 20 英亩混凝土，但拒绝建造避难所
卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
随着美国军队减少在欧洲和中东的存在以“转向太平洋”，美国空军正在对基础设施进行重大投资，以加快作战节奏和扩大部署。安德森空军基地 (UAM) 是支撑整个印太战区的第二岛链中最重要的基地之一。
安德森基地是少数拥有诺斯罗普·格鲁曼 B-2 精神隐形轰炸机等关键平台的基地之一。因此，美国空军正在推进一项浇筑 20 英亩混凝土的计划，该计划将大幅扩大停机坪停车位。该建设计划原本打算成为与新加坡共和国空军扩大联合设施的一部分，但由于他们退出，美国空军仍在推进。
持续推动的原因在于空军越来越注重敏捷作战运用，强调灵活性和不可预测性。美国空军希望不再使用可预测的空军基地作为隐形轰炸机的高价值平台，因为它推出了世界上第一架第六代飞机 NG B-21 Raider。回到建设选择，与简单地在机场增加更多“停车位”的价值相比，这些飞机并没有从新的庇护所中受益显着。
决定在安德森空军基地建造大型开放式停机坪，而不是建造防护掩体，反映了五角大楼计划如何在印太地区导弹交火中生存的根本转变。在与中国的冲突中，永久性机库是一种负担。现代卫星图像确保它们的精确坐标被绘制出来，使它们很容易成为远程弹道导弹和巡航导弹的目标。空军没有试图用混凝土墙来吸收导弹袭击，而是通过其 ACE 作战概念押注于速度和机动性。
第五代隐形战斗机，包括空军洛克希德·马丁公司的 F-22 猛禽战斗机以及空军、海军和海军陆战队的 F-35 改型战斗机，均处于领先地位。由于它们的隐形外形需要在内部携带武器，因此它们的弹匣深度有限。它们的主要作用是渗透有争议的空域，绘制敌方雷达和导弹电池的地图，并将这些坐标与舰队的其他部分安全地进行数据链接。重型弹药由位于更靠后的非隐形或远程平台携带。
波音 F-15EX Eagle II 缺乏隐身性，但拥有 29,500 磅（13,380 公斤）的有效载荷能力，可充当防区外导弹卡车。它可以向 F-35 识别的目标发射超大型高超音速武器。 B-52 和下一代 B-21 轰炸机在安德森扩大的停机坪上执行远程打击，增强了这种火力。
与此同时，海军 P-8 海神飞机利用该基地维持持续的海上巡逻循环，确保海上交通线安全并跟踪敌方潜艇在菲律宾海的动向。
袭击者比之前的 B-2 更小，可以放入标准战斗机掩体中。然而，空军选择不建造这些飞机，以便仍能容纳更大的飞机，例如即将进行的升级，将使服役时间最长的轰炸机过渡到新的数字化标准。波音 B-52J 同温层堡垒将充当导弹卡车，为空军全球打击司令部新的 Hi-Lo 舰队中的隐形 B-21 提供支持。
这两个平台将共同成为新型战略打击力量的核心。与此同时，美国空军希望容纳更广泛的自有飞机和波音 P-8A 海神海上巡逻机等联合资产。波塞冬以 737-800 客机机身为基础，是太平洋战区的一款关键飞机，是美国海军的主要 MPA。澳大利亚、新西兰、新加坡、韩国甚至印度等其他地区盟友也都使用它。
除了这些前线作战飞机之外，还有大量运输机和加油机，它们经常往返于同一空军基地，以支持运送物资的行动。洛克希德 C-5M 超级银河不需要原始的停机坪即可着陆，但它确实拥有像 B-52 一样的巨大翼展。波音 KC-135 Stratotanker 的机身类似于标志性的 707，虽然已接近尾声，但仍然至关重要。其继任者波音 KC-46A Pegasus 尺寸更大，基于该公司的 767 宽体机身。
在安德森机场增加大量不动产，将使其成为第一岛链行动的优越中转站和发射点。它还将使其成为美国大陆与部署到太平洋的远征军之间的空中桥梁更有价值的集结点。
机场的升级不仅仅是混凝土。新的燃料储存和加油基础设施将扩大机场的容量，并加快热坑加油操作，以提高作战节奏。这补充了停机坪上更灵活的停车位，停机坪不会受到硬质掩体的阻碍，否则会限制翼展并导致浪费时间来回移动飞机。雨水管理系统也将进行重大升级，以确保这些设施能够承受最猛烈的季风降雨，而不会降低容量。
为了保护其新投资，该基地将获得价值 80 亿美元的增强型综合防空系统，以保护地面上的一切。据军控中心称，该系统将创建一个 360 度多层防御盾，其中 16 个不同的电池分散在关岛各地。防御架构旨在拦截不同高度的威胁，从高空弹道导弹到低空巡航导弹和无人机。
空军还分配了数百万美元的翻修合同，以确保通信和人员营房的安全。飞机越集中意味着兵员和装备越多。与此同时，更先进的机身需要更先进的保障技术以及更高的安全性来保护机密设备和信息。这些投资将确保部署到安德森的所有飞机以及操作这些飞机的军人能够发挥其最大潜力。

title_en: United Crew Spots Passenger “Texting He Was Going To Hijack” Plane, Cockpit Locked Down
title_zh: 美联航机组人员发现乘客“发短信说他要劫持”飞机，驾驶舱被锁定
summary: A Las Vegas flight turned back after cabin crew spotted a disturbing text and officers met the aircraft on return.
summary_zh: 一架拉斯维加斯航班在机组人员发现令人不安的文字后折返，官员在返程时接见了飞机。
body_en: Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

A security concern on a routine United Airlines flight from Las Vegas to New York prompted the aircraft to return to Vegas shortly after takeoff after a flight attendant reportedly spotted a passenger texting about hijacking the plane. The crew locked down the cockpit and returned to Las Vegas, where law enforcement met the aircraft.

United Airlines flight 1681 departed from Las Vegas Harry Reid International Airport (LAS) on Saturday, October 24, destined for the airline's base at Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR). According to air traffic control (ATC) audio, a flight attendant spotted the suspicious message shortly after takeoff and alerted the captain.
United Flight Returns After Passenger Messages About Hijacking

The service, operated by a United Boeing 737 MAX 8 , departed from Las Vegas on Saturday at 10:51 PM, 11 minutes behind its initial scheduled departure time of 10:40 PM. The plane had climbed to 24,000 feet when the threatening text message was spotted. According to ATC recordings shared by RobV on X , the passenger was not made aware that the crew had spotted the message until they were met by law enforcement on the flight's return to Las Vegas.

Once the flight crew was aware, the cockpit was subsequently locked down, and the captain made the decision to return to Las Vegas. The jet made a U-turn over the Arizona ghost town of Oak Grove, before taking a number of turns prior to the aircraft's arrival back into the City of Sin.
"The passenger doesn’t know anything is going on. The flight attendant saw him texting that he was going to hijack the aircraft."

Data from Simple Flying's Flight Tracker identifies the plane landed back into Las Vegas at 11:42 PM, around 50 minutes after the plane's initial departure. Simple Flying reached out to United for comment on the flight; however, an airline spokesperson could not immediately be reached.

After the flight crew was made aware of the suspicious message , the aircraft declared a general emergency, squawking 7700. This permitted the jet to receive priority to return to Vegas. The aircraft was carrying fuel for the nearly six-hour flight to Newark and was therefore above its normal landing weight.

The pilot told ATC that the plane had around 24,800 pounds (11,249 kg) of fuel for the flight to Newark, which resulted in an overweight landing. The 737 cannot dump fuel , so the plane returned to Las Vegas slower than usual, in an attempt to burn off as much fuel as possible. The captain also warned air traffic control that they may require the full length of Runway 26L.

The aircraft landed safely on Runway 26L. Law enforcement met the plane and spoke with the passenger, who reportedly remained unaware of the concern. The flight was then delayed overnight after the crew timed out, and a replacement service departed at 7:03 AM on Sunday, arriving in Newark more than eight hours late.

The United plane at the center of the incident was N17310 , a 737 MAX 8 that was first delivered to United in 2023. Configured with a two-class layout, it can accommodate up to 166 passengers with both Domestic First and United Main Cabin onboard.
body_zh: 记者 – Aaron 是一名航空和旅行记者，在旅行和旅游业拥有 14 年的经验。他的背景涵盖机场运营、航空基础设施和旅游咨询，曾与新西兰、欧洲和北美的全球组织合作。
Aaron 将行业专业知识与五大洲超过 52 个国家/地区的第一手旅行经验相结合，涵盖航空公司、机场、航空政策和更广泛的旅行领域。他居住在新西兰坎特伯雷。
他的作品发表在《Simple Flying》上，并受到 MSN、SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel、EIN News、Pakistan Defence 和 Climate Depot 的专题报道。
据报道，联合航空从拉斯维加斯飞往纽约的例行航班因安全问题，在一名空乘人员发现一名乘客发短信称劫机后，飞机在起飞后不久就返回维加斯。机组人员锁定了驾驶舱并返回拉斯维加斯，执法人员在那里与飞机会面。
联合航空 1681 号航班于 10 月 24 日星期六从拉斯维加斯哈利·里德国际机场 (LAS) 起飞，目的地是纽瓦克自由国际机场 (EWR) 的航空公司基地。根据空中交通管制（ATC）的音频，一名空乘人员在起飞后不久发现了可疑信息，并向机长发出警报。
乘客收到有关劫机的消息后，美联航航班返回
该航班由联合航空波音 737 MAX 8 运营，于周六晚上 10:51 从拉斯维加斯起飞，比最初计划的晚上 10:40 起飞时间晚了 11 分钟。当这条威胁短信被发现时，飞机已经爬升至 24,000 英尺的高度。根据 RobV 在 X 上分享的 ATC 录音，直到执法人员在航班返回拉斯维加斯时与乘客会面时，乘客才意识到机组人员已经发现了这条消息。
机组人员意识到后，驾驶舱随后被封锁，机长决定返回拉斯维加斯。这架喷气式飞机在亚利桑那州鬼城奥克格罗夫上空掉头，然后在飞机返回罪恶之城之前转弯了一些。
“这名乘客不知道发生了什么事。空乘人员看到他发短信说他要劫持飞机。”
Simple Flying 航班跟踪器的数据显示，飞机于晚上 11:42 降落返回拉斯维加斯，距离飞机首次起飞大约 50 分钟。 Simple Flying 联系了美联航，征求对此次航班的评论；不过，无法立即联系到航空公司发言人。
