机组人员得知可疑消息后，飞机宣布进入紧急状态，并发出 7700 警报。这使得飞机能够优先返回维加斯。这架飞机携带的燃料用于飞往纽瓦克的近六个小时的飞行，因此超出了正常着陆重量。
飞行员告诉 ATC，这架飞往纽瓦克的航班大约有 24,800 磅（11,249 公斤）燃油，导致着陆时超重。 737 无法倾倒燃油，因此飞机返回拉斯维加斯的速度比平常慢，试图燃烧掉尽可能多的燃油。机长还警告空中交通管制人员，他们可能需要 26L 跑道的全长。
飞机安全降落在26L跑道上。执法部门与飞机会面并与乘客交谈，据报道，乘客仍然不知道这一问题。由于机组人员超时，该航班于夜间延误，周日上午 7:03 起飞，晚点 8 个多小时抵达纽瓦克。
事件中的美联航飞机是 N17310，这是一架 737 MAX 8，于 2023 年首次交付给美联航。该飞机采用两舱布局，最多可容纳 166 名乘客，机上设有国内头等舱和美联航主舱。

title_en: Allegiant orders six more Boeing 737 MAX jets for 2028 delivery
title_zh: Allegiant 又订购了六架波音 737 MAX 喷气式飞机，将于 2028 年交付
summary: Allegiant Air has ordered six additional Boeing 737 MAX aircraft for delivery in 2028, exercising its first purchase… The post Allegiant orders six more Boeing 737 MAX jets for 2028 delivery appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 忠诚航空已额外订购六架波音 737 MAX 飞机，将于 2028 年交付，这是其首次采购……忠诚航空订购了六架波音 737 MAX 飞机。
body_en: Allegiant Air has ordered six additional Boeing 737 MAX aircraft for delivery in 2028, exercising its first purchase options under an agreement signed with Boeing in 2021.

The Las Vegas-based airline disclosed the purchase on October 23, 2026. The six 737-8s bring its firm purchases under the agreement to 56 aircraft, of which 22 had been delivered as of October 23. Allegiant retains options for another 74 jets.
Allegiant listed the six aircraft’s combined list price at more than $720 million before discounts and price adjustments through delivery. It did not disclose the negotiated purchase price.

The order extends Allegiant’s investment in new Boeing aircraft after years of building its low-cost operation largely around used jets. When it announced the original 50-aircraft purchase in January 2022, Allegiant operated 108 Airbus A319s and A320s.

The original deal included the smaller 737-7 and higher-capacity 737-8-200, with options for 50 more aircraft. Allegiant said the new jets would allow it to replace retiring aircraft and expand its fleet while lowering fuel consumption.
Allegiant originally expected to receive its first MAX in 2023 and all 50 firm aircraft by the end of 2025, but deliveries were delayed. Its first 737-8-200 arrived in September 2024.

In November 2024, the airline amended its agreement with Boeing to reduce the number of aircraft arriving in 2024 and 2025 and extend deliveries of the original order through the end of 2027. Allegiant said that agreement also included benefits and other considerations related to the delays.

The first Allegiant MAX entered passenger service in October 2024. In an investor presentation that month, Allegiant said delivery delays were costing it approximately $30 million annually and that it was working with Boeing to seek compensation.

At the time of the original announcement, Allegiant said the MAX aircraft would burn approximately 20% less fuel than its older Airbus A320-family jets while offering more seats. The airline also signed a 12-year maintenance agreement with CFM International covering the new aircraft’s LEAP-1B engines.
The latest purchase leaves 34 firm aircraft still to be delivered under the Boeing agreement.
The post Allegiant orders six more Boeing 737 MAX jets for 2028 delivery appeared first on AeroTime .
body_zh: 忠实航空已额外订购了六架波音 737 MAX 飞机，将于 2028 年交付，根据 2021 年与波音公司签署的协议行使首次购买选择权。
这家总部位于拉斯维加斯的航空公司于 2026 年 10 月 23 日披露了此次采购事宜。这家 6 架 737-8 飞机将根据协议确定采购 56 架飞机，其中 22 架已于 10 月 23 日交付。Allegiant 保留另外 74 架喷气式飞机的选择权。
Allegiant 列出的六架飞机在折扣和交付价格调整前的总标价超过 7.2 亿美元。它没有透露协商的购买价格。
在多年来主要围绕二手飞机建立低成本运营之后，该订单扩大了忠诚公司对新型波音飞机的投资。当忠实于 2022 年 1 月宣布最初购买 50 架飞机时，运营着 108 架空客 A319 和 A320。
最初的交易包括较小的 737-7 和容量较大的 737-8-200，以及另外 50 架飞机的选择。 Allegiant 表示，新飞机将使其能够替换退役的飞机并扩大机队，同时降低燃油消耗。
Allegiant 最初预计于 2023 年接收第一架 MAX，并于 2025 年底接收全部 50 架飞机，但交付被推迟。首架 737-8-200 于 2024 年 9 月抵达。
2024 年 11 月，该航空公司修改了与波音公司的协议，减少了 2024 年和 2025 年抵达的飞机数量，并将原始订单的交付期限延长至 2027 年底。Allegiant 表示，该协议还包括与延误相关的好处和其他考虑因素。
第一架 Allegiant MAX 于 2024 年 10 月投入客运服务。在当月的投资者介绍中，Allegiant 表示，交付延误每年给该公司造成约 3000 万美元的损失，该公司正在与波音公司合作寻求赔偿。
在最初发布公告时，Allegiant 表示 MAX 飞机将比其旧款空客 A320 系列飞机燃烧约 20% 的燃油，同时提供更多座位。该航空公司还与 CFM International 签署了一份为期 12 年的维护协议，涵盖新飞机的 LEAP-1B 发动机。
根据波音协议，最新购买的飞机仍有 34 架飞机有待交付。
Allegiant 又订购了 6 架波音 737 MAX 喷气式飞机，将于 2028 年交付，这一消息首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

title_en: Emirates Boss Names 3 US Cities That Could Land Their First Nonstop Flights To Dubai
title_zh: 阿联酋航空老板列出了 3 个可能开通首个直飞迪拜航班的美国城市
summary: The airline is weighing up three new US gateways as it awaits its delayed next-generation aircraft.
summary_zh: 该航空公司正在权衡三个新的美国门户，等待其推迟的下一代飞机。
body_en: Luke has over a decade of experience as a travel writer and aviation analyst. As a passionate traveler based across the Middle East and Asia, Luke offers strong insights into the industry. Based in South East Asia.

This article was updated on Monday, October 26, 2026, with additional information on airlines serving Dubai International Airport and Emirates' recovery. It was originally published on Sunday, October 25, 2026.

Emirates is eyeing three new US cities for nonstop flights to Dubai, potentially expanding its network beyond the 12 American airports it serves today. President Sir Tim Clark named Denver International Airport (DEN), Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW) and Philadelphia International Airport (PHL) as possible destinations during a conference this week.

None of the three airports currently have a nonstop connection to Dubai International Airport (DXB), although Denver has been heavily touted as a possible Emirates destination in the past. Its most recent US route launch was to Miami International Airport (MIA) in 2021, replacing flights to nearby Fort Lauderdale.
Emirates Considers Denver, Detroit And Philadelphia Flights

As reported by The Points Guy, Clark made the comments during an interview at Routes World in Frankfurt this week. Denver is the only one of the three cities to have been publicly linked to Emirates before, although Detroit and Philadelphia have reportedly been on the carrier's radar for years.

In spring 2025, then-Denver airport CEO Phil Washington said the airport's next new route will " likely be Dubai with Emirates ," although the carrier responded by saying it had no official plans to serve Denver. Notably, DEN currently has no nonstop flights to the Gulf region — its longest route is Turkish Airlines' 6,130-mile (9,865 km) service to Istanbul Airport (IST), which launched in June 2024.

It is also the only United Airlines hub Emirates does not already serve. The Dubai-based airline already serves six of United’s hubs in Newark, Chicago, Houston, Washington, San Francisco and Los Angeles. The two airlines have been codeshare partners since 2023. Meanwhile, Detroit is one of Delta Air Lines' largest hubs, while Philadelphia is an American Airlines stronghold ranking as its fifth-largest hub by flights, and a key transatlantic gateway.

However, Emirates already serves Newark and JFK, located about 80 miles (129 km) and 94 miles (151 km) from Philadelphia, respectively. Of the three potential routes, Philadelphia would be the shortest at 6,928 miles (11,150 km) from Dubai, followed by Detroit at 7,083 miles (11,400 km). Denver would be the longest at 7,758 miles (12,485 km), although it wouldn't become the longest US route in Emirates' network — that would be Los Angeles at 8,326 miles (13,399 km).
Routes Would Depend On Capacity And Aircraft Deliveries

Whether these routes become a reality is heavily dependent on the carrier restoring capacity and expanding its fleet. Emirates is still awaiting delivery of its first Boeing 777-9 widebody, with its current timeline expecting the first to arrive in May or June 2027 . This would be seven years later than initially planned.

Until the new aircraft arrive, Emirates is extending the service lives of its Airbus A380s and Boeing 777-300ERs through a $5 billion cabin retrofit program. The airline now expects to keep its A380s flying into the early 2040s. It has also told Boeing that it will reject early-production 777X aircraft and accept only newly built examples, due to the extensive change incorporation work these early-build airframes require.

Clark did not specify which aircraft Emirates might use for any of the three cities. None of them currently receive year-round A380 service, although Denver has seen seasonal A380 flights by Lufthansa over the last two summers. Clark pointed to the airline's huge order book, which includes more than 300 Airbus A350s, Boeing 787s and Boeing 777Xs, stating that there are very few cities around the world the airline could not reach if it wanted to.
Emirates has not added a brand-new US airport to its network since June 2021, when it began flying to Miami. Before that, the airline’s last addition was Newark in March 2017, flown via Athens.

However, the airline is adding a brand-new aircraft type to its US network in the Airbus A350-900. The aircraft is set to replace the Boeing 777-300ER on flights to Orlando, offering 298 seats (32 business, 28 premium economy, 238 economy). The A350 will take over from the 777 on November 1.
Emergency squawks, holds, NOTAMs — live signals, no signup.

Of the three cities Clark named, Philadelphia is the only one already served by a Gulf airline , namely Qatar Airways. The Qatari airline resumed flights from Doha in August, soon after American Airlines permanently dropped its own Philadelphia–Doha route in June. Denver and Detroit, by contrast, currently have no Gulf carrier service at all, potentially giving Emirates a more direct opportunity to establish a new market.
Emirates Nears Full Strength As Airlines Stay Out Of Dubai

Emirates is getting closer to restoring its full capacity after months of disruption. Clark said the airline had rebuilt 91% of its pre-crisis capacity, with revenues already ahead of 2025 despite airspace closures and rising fuel costs. He added that demand across Emirates’ key markets remains strong, also confirming that the airline remains profitable.
body_zh: 卢克拥有十多年的旅行作家和航空分析师经验。作为一名遍及中东和亚洲的热情旅行者，卢克对该行业提供了深刻的见解。总部位于东南亚。
本文于 2026 年 10 月 26 日星期一更新，提供了有关为迪拜国际机场提供服务的航空公司和阿联酋航空恢复情况的更多信息。它最初于 2026 年 10 月 25 日星期日发布。
阿联酋航空正在考虑在美国的三个新城市开设飞往迪拜的直飞航班，从而可能将其网络扩展到目前服务的 12 个美国机场之外。总统蒂姆·克拉克爵士在本周的一次会议上将丹佛国际机场 (DEN)、底特律大都会韦恩县机场 (DTW) 和费城国际机场 (PHL) 指定为可能的目的地。
尽管丹佛过去曾被大力宣传为阿联酋航空可能的目的地，但目前这三个机场都没有直达迪拜国际机场 (DXB) 的航班。其最近推出的美国航线是 2021 年飞往迈阿密国际机场 (MIA) 的航班，取代飞往附近劳德代尔堡的航班。
阿联酋航空考虑飞往丹佛、底特律和费城的航班
据 The Points Guy 报道，克拉克本周在法兰克福的 Routes World 接受采访时发表了上述言论。丹佛是之前与阿联酋航空公开联系的三个城市中唯一的一个，尽管据报道底特律和费城多年来一直受到阿联酋航空的关注。
2025 年春季，当时的丹佛机场首席执行官菲尔·华盛顿 (Phil Washington) 表示，该机场的下一条新航线“可能是阿联酋航空的迪拜航线”，尽管该航空公司回应称没有为丹佛提供服务的正式计划。值得注意的是，DEN 目前没有飞往海湾地区的直飞航班 - 其最长的航线是土耳其航空于 2024 年 6 月推出的飞往伊斯坦布尔机场 (IST) 的 6,130 英里（9,865 公里）航班。
这也是阿联酋航空尚未提供服务的唯一联合航空枢纽。这家总部位于迪拜的航空公司已为美联航位于纽瓦克、芝加哥、休斯顿、华盛顿、旧金山和洛杉矶的六个枢纽提供服务。自 2023 年以来，两家航空公司一直是代码共享合作伙伴。同时，底特律是达美航空最大的枢纽之一，而费城是美国航空的据点，按航班排名是其第五大枢纽，也是重要的跨大西洋门户。

不过，阿联酋航空已经开通了纽瓦克和肯尼迪机场的航班，这两个机场分别距离费城约 80 英里（129 公里）和 94 英里（151 公里）。在这三条潜在航线中，费城是最短的，距离迪拜 6,928 英里（11,150 公里），其次是底特律，距离 7,083 英里（11,400 公里）。丹佛将是最长的航线，全长 7,758 英里（12,485 公里），尽管它不会成为阿联酋航空网络中最长的美国航线——洛杉矶为 8,326 英里（13,399 公里）。
航线将取决于运力和飞机交付量
这些航线能否成为现实，很大程度上取决于航空公司恢复运力和扩大机队规模。阿联酋航空仍在等待第一架波音 777-9 宽体飞机的交付，目前的时间表预计第一架飞机将于 2027 年 5 月或 6 月抵达。这比最初计划晚了七年。
在新飞机到来之前，阿联酋航空将通过价值 50 亿美元的客舱改造计划延长空客 A380 和波音 777-300ER 的使用寿命。该航空公司目前预计 A380 飞机将继续运营至 2040 年代初期。它还告诉波音公司，将拒绝早期生产的 777X 飞机，只接受新建的飞机，因为这些早期制造的机身需要进行大量的变更合并工作。
克拉克没有具体说明阿联酋航空可能在这三个城市中使用哪架飞机。尽管汉莎航空在过去两个夏天丹佛有季节性 A380 航班，但目前没有一家航空公司提供全年 A380 航班服务。克拉克指出，该航空公司拥有庞大的订单，其中包括 300 多架空客 A350、波音 787 和波音 777X 飞机，并表示如果该航空公司愿意的话，世界上几乎没有城市无法到达。
自 2021 年 6 月开始飞往迈阿密以来，阿联酋航空尚未在其网络中添加全新的美国机场。在此之前，该航空公司最后一次新增航班是 2017 年 3 月飞往纽瓦克，经停雅典。
然而，该航空公司正在其美国网络中添加一种全新的机型：空客 A350-900。该飞机将取代飞往奥兰多的波音 777-300ER，提供 298 个座位（32 个商务舱、28 个豪华经济舱、238 个经济舱）。 A350 将于 11 月 1 日接替 777。
紧急呼叫、等待、航行通告 — 实时信号，无需注册。
在克拉克点名的三个城市中，费城是唯一一个已经有海湾航空公司（即卡塔尔航空）提供服务的城市。卡塔尔航空公司于 8 月恢复了从多哈出发的航班，此前不久，美国航空公司于 6 月永久取消了自己的费城 - 多哈航线。相比之下，丹佛和底特律目前根本没有海湾航空公司的服务，这可能为阿联酋航空提供更直接的机会来建立新市场。
由于航空公司不再涉足迪拜，阿联酋航空已接近全面实力
经过数月的中断后，阿联酋航空即将恢复其全部运力。克拉克表示，该航空公司已重建了危机前 91% 的运力，尽管空域关闭且燃油成本上涨，但收入已在 2025 年之前实现。他补充说，阿联酋航空主要市场的需求仍然强劲，这也证实了该航空公司仍然盈利。

title_en: Lufthansa and SWISS delay Dubai return due to ‘volatility’ around Middle East
title_zh: 由于中东地区的“波动”，汉莎航空和瑞士航空推迟返回迪拜
summary: Lufthansa Group carriers Lufthansa, SWISS and Eurowings have delayed their planned return to Dubai after deciding that the… The post Lufthansa and SWISS delay Dubai return due to ‘volatility’ around Middle East appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 汉莎航空集团旗下的航空公司汉莎航空、瑞士航空和欧洲之翼航空在决定……后推迟了返回迪拜的计划。
body_en: Lufthansa Group carriers Lufthansa, SWISS and Eurowings have delayed their planned return to Dubai after deciding that the situation in the Middle East remains too unsettled.
On October 23, 2026, the Lufthansa, SWISS and Eurowings jointly confirmed that they would postpone their planned resumption of flights to Dubai until November 25, 2026.
Previously, Lufthansa and SWISS were scheduled to restart their service on October 25, 2026, and Eurowings on November 1, 2026.
The airlines said the decision was made “in light of the current situation and outlook in the Middle East”. Neither of the airlines have flown to Dubai since March 2026.
Lufthansa said that passengers affected by the postponing will be contacted directly by their respective airlines and will be offered flexible rebooking options or a full refund.
For their 2026/2027 winter schedule, Lufthansa has planned up to five weekly flights to Dubai from both Frankfurt Airport (FRA) and Munich Airport (MUC).
SWISS plans to operate daily flights to Dubai from Zurich (ZRH) as does Eurowings from Berlin (BER).
Austrian Airlines is scheduled to operate five weekly flights from Vienna (VIE), starting December 12, 2026.
Eurowings will not operate the planned flights from Cologne/Bonn and Stuttgart to Dubai during the 2026/2027 winter schedule.
At peak operation, Lufthansa Group airlines will offer up to 28 weekly flights to and from Dubai.

“The Lufthansa Group continuously monitors and evaluates the situation in the Middle East and is in close contact with the relevant authorities,” the company said. “The safety of passengers and crew is always the top priority for the Lufthansa Group. Due to the continued volatility of the situation in the region, short-notice adjustments to individual routes may be necessary.”
The post Lufthansa and SWISS delay Dubai return due to ‘volatility’ around Middle East appeared first on AeroTime .
body_zh: 汉莎航空集团旗下的航空公司汉莎航空、瑞士航空和欧洲之翼航空在认为中东局势仍然过于不稳定后，推迟了返回迪拜的计划。
2026年10月23日，汉莎航空、瑞士国际航空和欧洲之翼航空联合确认，将原定恢复飞往迪拜的航班推迟至2026年11月25日。
此前，汉莎航空和瑞航计划于2026年10月25日恢复服务，欧洲之翼航空计划于2026年11月1日恢复服务。
航空公司表示，这一决定是“根据中东当前局势和前景”做出的。自 2026 年 3 月以来，两家航空公司都没有飞往迪拜的航班。
汉莎航空表示，受影响的乘客将由各自的航空公司直接联系，并获得灵活的重新预订选项或全额退款。
对于 2026/2027 年冬季航班计划，汉莎航空计划每周有多达 5 趟从法兰克福机场 (FRA) 和慕尼黑机场 (MUC) 飞往迪拜的航班。
瑞航计划每天运营从苏黎世 (ZRH) 飞往迪拜的航班，欧洲之翼航空 (Eurowings) 也运营从柏林 (BER) 飞往迪拜的航班。
奥地利航空计划从 2026 年 12 月 12 日起每周运营 5 趟从维也纳 (VIE) 出发的航班。
欧洲之翼航空将不会在 2026/2027 年冬季航班计划中运营从科隆/波恩和斯图加特飞往迪拜的计划航班。
在运营高峰期，汉莎航空集团航空公司每周将提供多达 28 趟往返迪拜的航班。
该公司表示：“汉莎集团持续监测和评估中东局势，并与有关当局保持密切联系。” “乘客和机组人员的安全始终是汉莎航空集团的首要任务。由于该地区局势持续波动，可能有必要对个别航线进行临时通知调整。”
汉莎航空和瑞士航空因中东地区“波动”而延迟返回迪拜的消息首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

title_en: Citi AAdvantage Executive Card Adds $200 Annual InKind Dining Credit
title_zh: Citi AAdvantage Executive 卡可添加 200 美元年度 InKind 餐饮积分
summary: The Citi AAdvantage Executive Card now offers up to $200 in annual InKind dining credits, split into two $100 halves. Here's how to activate it and why I love InKind.

body_en: The Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard® ( learn more ) has just added an awesome new dining perk, which happens to be with my favorite dining app, InKind . Sure, I’ll take an extra $200 in InKind value without an annual fee increase. It’s nice when that happens!
Citi AAdvantage Executive Card InKind credit details

Effective immediately, eligible Citi AAdvantage Executive Card members will receive $200 in annual dining credits through inKind, the dining app that probably accounts for over half of my restaurant visits nowadays.

This up to $200 perk is semi-annual, so cardmembers can receive a $100 credit between January 1 and June 30, and a $100 credit between July 1 and December 31. This is an ongoing perk, and there’s no published end date as of now. This is also valid for both new and existing InKind users.

In order to take advantage of this, cardmembers will first have to download the InKind app and register (I’d recommend doing so through a refer-a-friend link — this can get you $25 off your first meal ).

Then once registered, cardmembers will have to add their Citi AAdvantage Executive Card as a payment method in their InKind profile. Once that’s done, you’ll immediately see a new section in the InKind app referencing this benefit.
Following this, when you dine at a participating InKind restaurant, just pay through the InKind app with your linked card, and then the credit will be issued.
InKind is a great app, and I love this card change

I use InKind all the time, and it’s really so much better than any other dining app, in my opinion. While I’d recommend checking out my full InKind review , let me highlight a few of my favorite aspects of the app
While there’s of course some variance, InKind has a lot of very high quality restaurants, and in some cases, I’ve even found new places that I love thanks to InKind
InKind offers at least 20% back on dining in the form of InKind credit; another trick is that InKind will often sell credit for 30-45% off, so that represents massive savings at these restaurants
The process of using InKind is really straightforward (there are no hoops to jump through), and you just have to pay for your meal with the app, which ends up saving you time

This also adds really meaningful value to the Citi AAdvantage Executive Card , in my opinion. It’s a card that I currently have — yes, it has a steep $695 annual fee, but for me it’s worthwhile as someone who primarily flies American.

On the most basic level, the card offers an Admirals Club membership for the primary member, and that’s worth more than the annual fee to me. That’s only the start of the benefits, though, and if you add even more value on top of that, all the better!

The Citi AAdvantage Executive Card now gets up to $200 in dining credits with InKind annually. This is a semi-annual credit, so you receive $100 in the first half of the year, and $100 in the second half of the year.

To take advantage of this, just enter your card number in the InKind app, and then you’ll automatically see details about this benefit there. Also make sure when you register for InKind, you use a refer-a-friend link, so you can get $25 off your first meal ( this is my link — others are free to leave their links in the comments).
If you don’t yet have InKind, this is a great time to give it a shot!
Anyone else happy to see this new InKind credit?

然后，注册后，持卡会员必须将其 Citi AAdvantage Executive 卡作为付款方式添加到其 InKind 个人资料中。完成后，您将立即在 InKind 应用程序中看到引用此优势的新部分。
此后，当您在参与活动的 InKind 餐厅用餐时，只需使用关联卡通过 InKind 应用程序付款，即可获得积分。
InKind 是一个很棒的应用程序，我喜欢这个卡片更改
我一直在使用 InKind，在我看来，它确实比任何其他餐饮应用程序都要好得多。虽然我建议您查看完整的 InKind 评论，但让我重点介绍一下该应用程序中我最喜欢的一些方面

使用 InKind 的过程非常简单（没有任何障碍），您只需使用该应用程序支付餐费，这最终节省了您的时间

Bids were solicited via the internet with one received. U.S. Army Contracting Command, Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, is the contracting activity (W911NF-17-D-0001). Contractor will provide engine teardown and overhaul, on-wing support/contract field teams, and engine parts and logistics. In addition, the contractor will provide all support required to fulfill this requirement, including but not limited to labor, materials, tools, equipment, parts, and transportation. Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Tinker AFB, Oklahoma, is the contracting activity (FA8105-17-D-0002). U.S. NAVY Avian LLC , Lexington Park, Maryland, is being awarded an $11,402,443 cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide support for the Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division’s Integrated System Evaluation Experimentation and Test Department (AIR-5.1). Services provided will include flight test engineering, programmatic, administrative, design, execution, analysis, evaluation, and reporting of tests and experiments of aircraft, unmanned air systems, weapons and weapons systems. The Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity (N00421-17-C-0049). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 8, 2017 U.S. NAVY Sierra Nevada Corp. , Rancho, California, is being awarded a $30,995,905 modification to a previously awarded firm-fixed-price, cost-plus-fixed-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (N00174-09-D-0003) to extend the ordering period and exercise Option Year 6 for the procurement and support of the transmitting set, countermeasures AN/PLT-5, to support explosive ordnance disposal personnel. The AN/PLT-5 is a man-portable system in support of the Joint Service Explosive Ordnance Disposal Counter Radio Controlled Improvised Explosive Device Electronic Warfare program. The Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technology Division, Indian Head, Maryland, is the contracting activity. Vector Planning and Services Inc. , San Diego, is being awarded a potential $17,910,070 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide cyberspace science, research, engineering, and technology integration. Support includes innovative technology assessment and development; rapid software development and prototyping; enabling capability training; security engineering; and cybersecurity risk management. This is one of four multiple-award contracts. All awardees will have the opportunity to compete for task orders during the ordering period. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Center Pacific, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N66001-17-D-0117). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 9, 2017 U.S. MISSILE DEFENSE AGENCY Lockheed Martin Space Systems Co. , Sunnyvale, California, was awarded a $53,052,807 competitive cost-plus-fixed-fee contract for a 36-month period with no options for the Multi-Object Kill Vehicle Technology Risk Reduction (TRR) effort. This contract represents part of the Missile Defense Agency’s technology risk reduction strategy to improve performance and reduce risk for a gimbaled seeker assembly, integrated avionics assembly, component integration and testing, and an advanced seeker. The Missile Defense Agency, Huntsville, Alabama, is the contracting activity (HQ0147-17-C-0002). The Capacity as a Service acquisition model allows Spawar to more accurately scale, up and down, its information technology (IT) infrastructure to meet evolving mission requirements. Savings are realized through no up-front costs and a “pay as you go” acquisition model, reducing waste usually associated with overbuying of IT equipment to eventually meet an expectation of mission requirement. Under this contract, ViON is responsible for providing on-demand, on-premise computing, networking and storage solutions for a variety of systems and applications for the command’s research, development, testing and evaluation core infrastructures, laboratory and data center environments. This contract includes options, which if exercised, would bring the maximum contract value to $49,990,000. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N00039-17-D-0003). body_en: Autoflight V5000 Matrix william.moore@… Tue, 03/31/2026 - 07:48 The V5000 Matrix is a lift-plus-cruise hybrid-electric/all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft being developed by AutoFlight Europe GmbH. Unveiled in February 2026, the aircraft performed a remotely piloted transition from thrustborne hover to wingborne cruise, demonstrating that flight testing is already underway. Industry commentators have suggested that entry into service could be as soon as 2027/2028, although there is no confirmation of this. Certification is to be sought from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) under powered-lift regulations. Structure and Powertrain The Matrix pushes regulations to their maximum, being a 10 seat eVTOL with a maximum take-off weight of 5,700kg (hybrid version). The aircraft could be configured in a 6-seat VIP layout, or a 9-seat business layout plus a pilot. It will also feature a lavatory, the first eVTOL design to incorporate this, an indication of its lengthier flight duration capabilities. An uncrewed cargo variant is also in development. The intended market is more regional-focused than previous eVTOL designs. Structurally, the V5000 is an evolution of the previous Autoflight Prosperity I and CarryAll cargo variant. It features a long, aerodynamic cabin with panoramic viewing windows and skid-style landing gear. A main high wing is complemented by two smaller wings to the front and rear of the aircraft, with three booms extending across all three wings parallel to the cabin, on each side. 20 two-blade fixed propellers are mounted to the six booms to provide lift, while eight cruise propellers provide forward thrust, four mounted to the front and four to the rear. body_en: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017. Twenty new-built aircraft will be purchased in the country’s first acquisition of a European combat aircraft after decades of operating new and secondhand U.S.-built fighters. But Turkey’s Eurofighter order could more than double in size, according to Turkish Defense Minister Yasar Guler. He declared that Ankara would also buy another 24 aircraft second hand, 12 each from Oman and Qatar. If those sales go through, Oman would be giving up Eurofighter operations. With deliveries of the new-build aircraft not due until 2030, delivering those second-hand aircraft—potentially as early as next year from Qatar, according to Guler—would allow Turkey to accelerate the Eurofighter’s entry into service and enable the retirement of older aircraft from its inventory, including the McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom. BAE Systems, which will produce the newly built aircraft in Warton, England, says it will receive £5.4 billion of the £8 billion deal. Included in the £5.4 billion are the aircraft and the weapons package from MBDA, including some integration work, potentially for Turkish indigenous weaponry. The remaining £2.6 billion is support and training activity, which will be contracted later, BAE Systems officials say. It is unclear whether the deal will ultimately include offsets to enable Turkish industry to become involved in the Eurofighter program and for Turkey to have a level of freedom of action for the fleet. After decades of facing numerous arms embargoes, Turkey often demands the ability to locally perform airframe, system and engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) in-country. The deal was struck during a meeting between UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Ankara. Starmer said the deal was a win for British workers and the wider UK defense industry. Government officials claim the order is “saving the Warton production line,” after concerns about a lack of new orders for UK-built Typhoons were expressed by workers unions. UK industry has a 37% share in the Eurofighter program and production of major component assemblies is being ramped up thanks to orders from the other Eurofighter partner nations including Germany, Italy and Spain. “Today’s announcement extends Typhoon production and preserves crucial sovereign skills which underpin the UK’s defense and security,” BAE Systems CEO Charles Woodburn said. The deal is another major boost for the UK defense industry, coming just weeks after the UK’s Type 26 frigates were selected by Norway in a £10 billion deal. UK Defense Secretary John Healey said the deal went beyond the procurement of aircraft. “It is the leading edge of the growing defense and industrial partnership between our two nations,” he said. As part of the visit, Starmer also visited the facilities of Turkish Aerospace Industries, where he was shown the indigenous Kaan combat aircraft. He was also exposed to the Hurjet advanced jet trainer, a potential candidate to replace the BAE Systems Hawk jet trainer in the UK Royal Air Force (RAF) inventory. The deal follows three years of negotiations, which have included lobbying of the German government for Berlin to lift a restriction on a Eurofighter sale after Erdoğan’s government arrested Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, who is seen as a serious presidential rival to Erdoğan in upcoming elections. The administration of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz lifted the sanctions in part because of the benefit to German industry. A memorandum of understanding between the UK and Turkish governments for a Eurofighter sale was agreed to in July. Turkey’s interest in the aircraft is driven in part by a need for a more capable air combat platform to be available in the interim until advanced versions of the Kaan aircraft are produced in the 2030s. Ankara’s decision to opt for a European fighter, meanwhile, will have been driven by a need to diversify sources of supply after facing sanctions from the U.S. over its purchase of a Russian air defense system and banishment from the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter program. The transfer of Omani and Qatari aircraft to Turkey begs questions over the future of additional Eurofighter orders from Qatar, which has long been linked to orders for a further 12 aircraft for a total of 36. Oman, meanwhile, appears to want to consolidate its fighter fleet around the Lockheed Martin F-16 Block 50. In BAE Systems’ 2023 full-year results, the company revealed that the Omani air force had chosen not to renew support arrangements for its Typhoons, and it is unclear how active that fleet now is. Buying these additional aircraft would mean Turkey would have a mix of three configurations in its fleet. Qatar’s aircraft have the Mk.0 version of the active electronically scanned array European Common Radar System (ECRS) radar, while Oman’s feature the mechanically scanned Captor sensor. In addition to the Eurofighter order, Erdoğan and Starmer also revealed they were working on a new trade and security pact. body_en: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototyping facility in Mojave, California, a source familiar with the project tells Aviation Week. A photo of the aircraft reviewed by Aviation Week revealed a completed, turbofan-powered aircraft parked within the Scaled Composites compound at the public airport. The Lotus UAS design in some ways resembles features of the newly revealed Lockheed Martin Project Vectis, with a long, slender fuselage positioned forward of the leading edges of the wings, capped by a nose with swept-back edges leading to a slender point. In many other respects, the Lotus and Vectis designs diverge. Unlike the engine inlet mounted low at mid-fuselage for the Vectis aircraft, the Lotus inlet sits high atop of the extreme aft section of its fuselage. The Lotus also sports sharply canted tails, breaking from the tailless-configured Vectis. Project Lotus appears to represent Northrop’s candidate for the U.S. Air Force’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) Increment 2 program, which is finalizing requirements for competitive prototypes ahead of a scheduled acquisition process next year. The photo reveals that Northrop has already built a demonstrator, perhaps gaining a step on Lockheed’s rival design, which is not scheduled to reach first flight until 2027. As Northrop’s rapid prototyping arm, the Scaled Composites facility frequently builds aircraft demonstrators in secret. Scaled Composites registered a turbofan-powered, fixed-wing aircraft identified only as Model 444 earlier this year with the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), which granted the organization the N444LX tail number. It is not clear if the registration represents Project Lotus or another undisclosed project. Northrop also is building the XRQ-73, also known as the Series Hybrid Electric Propulsion AiR Demonstration (Shepard), for DARPA. In response to questions about Project Lotus from Aviation Week, Northrop avoided direct answers, but spoke generally about its internal investments in autonomous aircraft. “Our investments prioritize production at speed and scale, without sacrificing performance or capability. The Northrop Grumman team has generated step-change advancements in production speed, weight and parts reduction, and overall cost efficiency. These advancements benefit the spectrum of autonomous capabilities we produce at Northrop Grumman for U.S. and international customers,” Northrop said. As Lockheed’s Project Vectis design revealed in September, Northrop’s Project Lotus represents one side in a long-running debate within industry and the Air Force over the future direction of the CCA fleet between concepts that emphasize greater survivability or lower cost. In 2024, the Air Force decided to seek a middle ground between cost and survivability with the selected competitive prototypes for the CCA Increment 1 program. The General Atomics Aeronautical Systems Inc. YFQ-42 and Anduril YFQ-44 are large aircraft that feature some low-observable, or stealth, technology. But the aircraft are larger and costlier than, for example, the Kratos XQ-58, and lack the stealthier features of Project Vectis and Project Lotus. In September, Air Force officials said they were considering the full spectrum of options for the Increment 2 CCA requirement, ranging from exquisite survivability to small, air-launched systems. Project Lotus also lends new insight into how Northrop’s internal CCA concepts have evolved from previous, publicly released ideas. As the Air Force competition for CCAs heated up in 2023, Northrop showed off the SG-1 and SG-2 concepts, which appeared similar to the cranked-kite planform of the U.S. Navy-funded X-47B demonstrator. Around the same time, Northrop also unveiled the Model 437 concept, an autonomous spinoff from the crewed Model 401 Sierra demonstrator. The Model 437 finally emerged as a piloted demonstrator aircraft in 2024. Earlier this year, Northrop announced that the aircraft had transitioned into the Beacon demonstrator, serving as a testbed for mission autonomy technology. body_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的莲花项目秘密揭晓 hockensmithawi…2025 年 10 月 27 日星期一 - 18:05 一位熟悉该项目的消息人士告诉《航空周刊》，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司已在该公司位于加利福尼亚州莫哈韦的规模化复合材料快速原型制造工厂秘密建造了一个大型新型无人驾驶飞机系统 (UAS)，称为“莲花项目”。 《航空周刊》查看的一张飞机照片显示，一架完工的涡轮风扇飞机停在公共机场的 Scaled Composites 园区内。莲花无人机的设计在某些方面类似于新推出的洛克希德·马丁公司 Vectis 项目的特征，其长而细长的机身位于机翼前缘的前面，其机头顶部有后掠边缘，通向细长的尖端。 Lotus 和 Vectis 的设计在许多其他方面存在差异。与 Vectis 飞机的发动机进气口安装在机身中部较低的位置不同，Lotus 进气口位于机身最后部的高处。 Lotus 还拥有急剧倾斜的尾部，与无尾配置的 Vectis 不同。 Lotus 项目似乎代表了诺斯罗普美国空军协同作战飞机 (CCA) Increment 2 计划的候选者，该计划将在明年预定的采购过程之前最终确定竞争性原型机的要求。这张照片显示，诺斯罗普公司已经制造了一架验证机，或许比洛克希德公司的竞争对手设计领先一步，后者预计要到 2027 年才能实现首飞。作为诺斯罗普公司的快速原型制造部门，Scaled Composites 工厂经常秘密制造飞机验证机。今年早些时候，Scaled Composites 向美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 注册了一架涡轮风扇动力固定翼飞机，型号为 444，并授予该组织 N444LX 尾号。目前尚不清楚该注册是否代表 Project Lotus 还是另一个未公开的项目。诺斯罗普还正在为 DARPA 建造 XRQ-73，也称为系列混合电动推进 AiR 演示（Shepard）。在回答《航空周刊》有关莲花项目的问题时，诺斯罗普避免直接回答，但笼统地谈到了其对自动驾驶飞机的内部投资。诺斯罗普表示：“我们的投资优先考虑速度和规模生产，而不牺牲性能或能力。诺斯罗普·格鲁曼团队在生产速度、重量和零件减少以及整体成本效率方面取得了巨大进步。这些进步有利于我们在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼为美国和国际客户生产的一系列自主能力。”正如洛克希德公司的 Vectis 项目设计在 9 月透露的那样，诺斯罗普的 Lotus 项目代表了工业界和空军内部关于 CCA 机队未来方向的长期争论中的一方，争论强调更高的生存能力或更低的成本。 2024 年，空军决定为 CCA Increment 1 计划选定具有竞争力的原型机，在成本和生存能力之间寻求中间立场。通用原子航空系统公司的 YFQ-42 和 Anduril YFQ-44 是大型飞机，采用一些低可观测或隐形技术。但该飞机比 Kratos XQ-58 等飞机更大、更昂贵，并且缺乏 Project Vectis 和 Project Lotus 的隐身功能。 9 月，空军官员表示，他们正在考虑满足 Increment 2 CCA 要求的全方位选择，从出色的生存能力到小型空射系统。 Lotus 项目还为诺斯罗普内部 CCA 概念如何从之前公开发布的想法演变而来提供了新的见解。随着 2023 年空军 CCA 竞争的白热化，诺斯罗普展示了 SG-1 和 SG-2 概念，它们看起来类似于美国海军资助的 X-47B 验证机的曲柄风筝平面图。大约在同一时间，诺斯罗普还推出了 Model 437 概念车，这是载人 Model 401 Sierra 验证机的自主衍生产品。 437 型最终于 2024 年成为有人驾驶验证机。今年早些时候，诺斯罗普宣布该飞机已转变为 Beacon 验证机，作为任务自主技术的测试平台。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 《航空周刊与航天技术》，2025 年 11 月 10 日 文章类型 文章主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者 Steve Trimble 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 航空周刊与航天技术 从列表中排除？没有标签：UAS、洛克希德·马丁公司、诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司、协同作战飞机 (CCA) 门控 AWST-MRO ASD 特色图片 snapshot_2025-10-27_scaled_composites_from_gmaps.png 二级类别/子类别 航空航天防御飞机与推进系统 标题中是否有 iframe？关闭 知识中心特色内容 关闭 不呈现广告 关闭 暂时设置为 AWIN 免费增值 关闭

body_en: Second B-21 Enters Flight Test In Palmdale hockensmithawi… Thu, 09/11/2025 - 18:36 The B-21 Raider program completed the first flight of a second airborne test aircraft in Palmdale, California on Sept. 11, clearing a key milestone a month before the 10th anniversary of the U.S. Air Force contract award to Northrop Grumman. Witnesses posted video on social media showing the B-21 flight-test aircraft passing overhead with wheels retracted and followed by a Lockheed Martin F-16 chase plane. “We can now expedite critical evaluations of mission systems and weapons capabilities, directly supporting the strategic deterrence and combat effectiveness envisioned for this aircraft,” Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said. Northrop assembles all B-21s inside Building 401 on Site 4 of the Air Force’s Plant 42 complex at Palmdale Regional Airport. New test aircraft must fly out of the public airport after they have been assembled, before they can relocate to the secure area of nearby Edwards Air Force Base. The milestone comes nearly 22 months after Northrop completed the maiden sortie of the first flight test version of the B-21 on Nov. 10, 2023. The company has also delivered to the Air Force two more fully assembled airframes, which are reserved for static and fatigue testing on the ground. Two more flight-test aircraft have been in some stage of assembly since at least February 2022. Air Force officials say the program remains on track to clear the initial operational capability milestone in the mid-2020s. Northrop won the $21.4 billion contract in October 2015 for the engineering and manufacturing development phase of the Long-Range Strike Bomber, which the Air Force later rechristened as the B-21 Raider. The Air Force also signed orders with Northrop for the first two-year lots of low-rate initial production. The first prototype VT35 has completed final assembly and is now undergoing flight testing, with the first public flight occurring in December 2025. Certification will be with the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC), as with EHang’s EH216-S, and certification is expected to be accelerated owing to the company’s experience certifying the previous model. Structure and Powertrain The VT35 seats two passengers inside a cabin featuring panoramic viewing windows. Each fan is individually powered by it’s own electric motor. Distributed electric propulsion (DEP) is the name given to this method of powering aircraft. No critical points of failure provide a high level of redundancy and will ensure safety onboard. The aircraft design was originally developed by Volkswagen China and was transferred to Diamond following a deal between the two companies in February 2024. A subscale prototype of the V.MO first flew in 2022. The full-scale aircraft design was unveiled at the Zhuhai Airshow in November 2024. No official certification plans have been announced. Structure and Powertrain The V.MO seats a pilot and four passengers in a streamlined cabin. The aircraft features a twin-boom connected by fore and aft wings, with eight vertical lift fans distributed along the booms. The aircraft features two pusher propellers, providing propulsion during wing-borne cruise flight. The aircraft features distributed electric propulsion (DEP), with each propeller powered by its own electric motor. This design approach provides high redundancy and reliability by eliminating critical points of failure. title_en: Transfer Citi ThankYou Points To Cathay Pacific With 10% Bonus: Worth It?
title_zh: 将花旗感谢积分转移至国泰航空并享受 10% 奖励：值得吗？
summary: Citi ThankYou is offering a 10% transfer bonus to Cathay Pacific in the US. It's not huge, but it's rare, and best suited to booking Cathay Pacific premium cabins.
summary_zh: CitiThankYou 向美国国泰航空提供 10% 的转账奖金。虽然不大，但是很少见，最适合订国泰公务
body_en: The Citi ThankYou program in the United States has just introduced a new transfer bonus to Cathay Pacific. While it’s not a particularly large percentage bonus, it is a rare offer, as I don’t remember the last time we saw an offer like this between the programs on Citi’s end. This offer is better than nothing, and Cathay Pacific’s program is best if you want to redeem directly for flights on the airline.
Citi ThankYou to Cathay Pacific transfer bonus promotion
Between October 25 and November 14, 2026, the Citi ThankYou program in the United States is offering a 10% bonus on points transfers to Cathay Pacific.

Ordinarily points transfer at a 1:1 ratio (in 1,000 point increments, assuming you have a premium Citi ThankYou card), while through this promotion you’d get 1,100 Cathay Pacific miles for every 1,000 Citi ThankYou points transferred.

There are several great cards earning Citi ThankYou points , including the Citi Strata Premier® Card ( learn more ) and Citi Strata Elite℠ Card ( learn more ), and it’s easy to combine points between the cards .

I should mention that in the past we’ve sometimes seen Cathay Pacific offer a bonus on points transfers from partners, but that was always on Cathay Pacific’s end, and not on Citi’s end. When we saw one of those offers, the transfer bonus wasn’t instant, so that wasn’t nearly as useful as this, in my opinion.

Cathay Pacific’s program partners with Amex Membership Rewards, Bilt Rewards, Capital One, and Citi ThankYou. All points transfers are 1:1, except Amex, which only has a 5:4 transfer ratio. For what it’s worth, Cathay Pacific miles expire after 18 months of inactivity. Any mileage earning or redemption opportunity would reset that timeline.
Is this Cathay Pacific transfer bonus worth it?
The Cathay Pacific Asia Miles program is one that has become increasingly useful over time, even though it’s one I historically haven’t really liked.

The single biggest thing to be aware of is that while Cathay Pacific belongs to the oneworld alliance, Cathay Pacific restricts a vast majority of its first and business class award space to members of the Asia Miles program, so that award space isn’t bookable through programs like Alaska Atmos Rewards and American AAdvantage . That didn’t used to be the case, and it’s the single biggest way that the value of this currency has improved.

There are also some situations where partner redemptions represent a good deal, though I’d say they’re the exception rather than the norm. For example, one valuable partner sweet spot of the program is that when booking through Asia Miles, British Airways flights have lower carrier imposed surcharges than through other programs.
Still, I’d say the primary value here is if you actually want to redeem for travel on Cathay Pacific in a premium cabin, since this is the most practical way to book that.

Through November 14, 2026, Citi ThankYou is offering a 10% bonus on points transfers to Cathay Pacific. While a 10% bonus isn’t huge, it’s better than nothing, and transfer bonuses to Cathay Pacific are incredibly rare. I definitely wouldn’t make a speculative transfer to take advantage of this, but if you’re going to move points anyway, you might as well get a bonus!

To be honest, I’m sort of tempted by this offer. I’d like to fly Cathay Pacific’s current first class one more time before it’s retired, particularly to check out Cathay Pacific’s new first class lounge , which still isn’t open to non-Cathay Pacific oneworld Emeralds.

body_zh: 美国的花旗感谢计划刚刚推出了国泰航空的新转会奖金。虽然这不是一个特别大的百分比奖金，但这是一个罕见的优惠，因为我不记得我们上次在花旗的项目之间看到这样的优惠是什么时候。这个优惠总比没有好，如果您想直接兑换航空公司的航班，国泰航空的计划是最好的选择。
花旗感谢国泰航空转乘奖金促销
2026年10月25日至11月14日期间，美国的花旗ThankYou计划为将积分转移至国泰航空提供10%的奖励。
一般情况下，积分转让比例为 1:1（以 1,000 积分为增量，假设您拥有高级花旗感谢卡），而通过此促销活动，每转让 1,000 点花旗感谢积分，即可获得 1,100 国泰航空里程。
有几张很棒的卡可赚取 CitiThankYou 积分，包括 Citi Strata Premier® 卡（了解更多）和 Citi Strata Elite℠ 卡（了解更多），并且可以轻松合并卡之间的积分。
我应该提一下，过去我们有时会看到国泰航空对合作伙伴的积分转让提供奖励，但那总是国泰航空这边，而不是花旗那边。当我们看到其中一项优惠时，转会奖金并不是即时的，所以在我看来，这并不像这个那么有用。
国泰航空的计划与美国运通会员奖励 (Amex Membership Rewards)、Bilt Rewards、第一资本 (Capital One) 和花旗感谢 (CitiThankYou) 合作。所有的积分转移都是1:1，除了Amex，它只有5:4的转移比例。无论如何，国泰航空里程在闲置 18 个月后就会过期。任何里程赚取或兑换机会都会重置该时间表。

随着时间的推移，国泰航空的“亚洲万里通”计划变得越来越有用，尽管我一直不太喜欢它。
最需要注意的一点是，虽然国泰航空属于 oneworld 联盟，但国泰航空将其绝大多数头等舱和商务舱奖励空间限制为“亚洲万里通”计划的会员，因此无法通过阿拉斯加 Atmos Rewards 和美国 AAdvantage 等计划预订奖励空间。过去情况并非如此，这是该货币价值提高的唯一最大方式。
在某些情况下，合作伙伴兑换也很划算，尽管我想说它们是例外而不是常态。例如，该计划的一个有价值的合作伙伴优势是，通过亚洲万里通预订英国航空航班时，承运商征收的附加费比通过其他计划低。
不过，我想说，这里的主要价值是，如果您真的想兑换国泰航空的高级舱位旅行，因为这是最实用的预订方式。
截至 2026 年 11 月 14 日，CitiThankYou 为将积分转移至国泰航空提供 10% 的奖励。虽然 10% 的奖金不算多，但总比没有好，而且转入国泰航空的奖金非常罕见。我绝对不会利用这一点进行投机性转移，但如果你无论如何都要转移积分，你不妨获得奖金！

title_en: JAL expands driverless towing tractors to Fukuoka after Haneda and Narita
title_zh: 继羽田机场和成田机场之后，日航将无人驾驶牵引车扩展到福冈
summary: Japan Airlines (JAL) announced it has started Level 4 autonomous towing tractor operations at Fukuoka Airport (FUK), making… The post JAL expands driverless towing tractors to Fukuoka after Haneda and Narita appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 日本航空 (JAL) 宣布已在福冈机场 (FUK) 启动 4 级自动牵引车运营，使得……日航扩大驾驶范围后
body_en: Japan Airlines (JAL) announced it has started Level 4 autonomous towing tractor operations at Fukuoka Airport (FUK), making it the third airport in its domestic network to use driverless vehicles for airside logistics.
The operations began on October 26, 2026, and were introduced together with airport operator Fukuoka International Airport Co, (FIAC).
Level 4 autonomy means the vehicles run fully driverless within specified operating conditions.

The move follows JAL’s launch of Level 4 towing tractor operations at Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND) and Narita International Airport (NRT) in December 2025. It is the airline’s first such deployment outside the Tokyo metropolitan area.

At Fukuoka, the autonomous tractors transport cargo containers along a route of about 1.7 kilometers between the domestic cargo terminal and the ground support equipment (GSE) holding area. JAL and FIAC have set joint operating rules and upgraded airside infrastructure to allow the vehicles to run without a driver.
The airline said demand for both domestic and international travel at Fukuoka continues to grow rapidly.

The tractors are EZTow electric vehicles made by TLD Robotics, formerly known as TractEasy. Each measures 3.2 meters long, 1.84 meters wide and 2.05 meters high, weighs 4.07 tons and can tow up to 14 tons.

JAL has been introducing advanced airside technologies since 2018 as part of the Autonomous Driving Committee initiative led by the Civil Aviation Bureau of Japan’s Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT).

The airline said automating routine ramp logistics helps offset labor shortages caused by Japan’s shrinking working-age population. It added that the electric vehicles produce zero emissions and reduce the risk of human error on busy ramps, where aircraft, specialized vehicles and ground staff operate side by side.
JAL plans to gradually expand its autonomous vehicle fleet, operating routes and coverage to more airports across Japan.

Alongside the towing tractors, the airline is using other automated equipment, including remote-controlled aircraft tugs, automated aircraft washing equipment and snowplows that can be run by a single operator.
With MLIT’s support, JAL also plans to deepen cooperation across the industry, including with All Nippon Airways (ANA), which is considering adopting similar systems.

body_zh: 日本航空 (JAL) 宣布已在福冈机场 (FUK) 启动 4 级自动牵引车运营，使其成为其国内网络中第三个使用无人驾驶车辆进行空侧物流的机场。
该运营于 2026 年 10 月 26 日开始，由机场运营商福冈国际机场有限公司 (FIAC) 共同推出。
4级自主意味着车辆在指定的运行条件下完全无人驾驶。
在此之前，日航于 2025 年 12 月在东京羽田机场 (HND) 和成田国际机场 (NRT) 启动了 4 级牵引车业务。这是该航空公司首次在东京都市区以外进行此类部署。
在福冈，自动牵引车沿着国内货运站和地面支持设备 (GSE) 存放区之间约 1.7 公里的路线运输货物集装箱。日航和 FIAC 制定了联合运营规则并升级了空侧基础设施，使车辆能够在没有驾驶员的情况下运行。
该航空公司表示，福冈的国内和国际旅行需求持续快速增长。
这些拖拉机是 TLD Robotics（原名 TractEasy）制造的 EZTow 电动汽车。每艘长 3.2 米、宽 1.84 米、高 2.05 米，重 4.07 吨，最多可拖曳 14 吨。
作为日本国土交通省 (MLIT) 民航局牵头的自动驾驶委员会计划的一部分，日航自 2018 年以来一直在引进先进的机场禁区技术。
该航空公司表示，自动化日常停机坪物流有助于抵消日本劳动年龄人口减少造成的劳动力短缺。该公司补充说，电动汽车实现零排放，并降低了繁忙坡道上人为错误的风险，飞机、特种车辆和地勤人员在坡道上并肩作业。
日航计划逐步扩大其自动驾驶车队、运营路线和覆盖范围，覆盖日本更多机场。
除了牵引车外，该航空公司还使用其他自动化设备，包括遥控飞机拖车、自动飞机清洗设备和可由单个操作员操作的扫雪机。
在国土交通省的支持下，日航还计划深化整个行业的合作，包括与正在考虑采用类似系统的全日空航空公司 (ANA) 的合作。
继羽田机场和成田机场首次出现在 AeroTime 上之后，日航将无人驾驶牵引车扩展到福冈。

title_en: Alaska Atmos Rewards Ascent Card Review: Big Bonus, Great Benefits
title_zh: 阿拉斯加Atmos奖励上升卡评论：大奖金，大福利

body_en: The Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® credit card is the mid-range personal credit card of Atmos Rewards, which is the loyalty program of Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines. This card is issued by Bank of America, and represents a great value. If you fly Alaska or Hawaiian with any frequency, this is a card you’ll probably want to pick up.

There are many reasons to consider picking up this card , especially if you fly Alaska or Hawaiian with any frequency. This post is my in-depth review of the Atmos Rewards Ascent Card, so let’s take a look at the card’s value proposition, for anyone who may be considering applying. This is an especially good time to apply, given the welcome offer that’s currently available.
Link: Learn more about the Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® credit card
Atmos Rewards Ascent Card summary & key details
Before I get into my Atmos Rewards Ascent Card review, here’s a brief summary of the key details of the card
Atmos Ascent Card welcome offer: Up to 80,000 Atmos Rewards points plus a $99 companion fare upon completing minimum spending

Atmos Ascent Card rewards earn rate: 3x Atmos Rewards points on Alaska & Hawaiian purchases, 2x points on eligible gas, EV charging stations, cable, streaming services, and local transit purchases (including rideshare), and 1x points on all other purchases; also earn one status point for every $3 spent, with no cap
Atmos Ascent Card benefits & credits: First checked bag free on Alaska & Hawaiian, preferred boarding on Alaska & Hawaiian flights, a $99 companion fare with $6,000 in annual spending, and more
Atmos Ascent Card foreign transaction fees: None
Atmos Ascent Card best for: Someone who flies Alaska and/or Hawaiian occasionally, and values perks like a free checked bag and preferred boarding
Below are what I consider to be the pros and cons of the Atmos Rewards Ascent Card .

Atmos Rewards Ascent Card pros Atmos Rewards Ascent Card cons Generous welcome bonus No airport lounge access Ability to earn $99 companion fare Not the best card for everyday spending Solid perks for travel on Alaska & Hawaiian No useful travel protections Atmos Ascent Card bonus, eligibility, & fee basics

The Atmos Rewards Ascent Card is the more basic personal card in the Atmos Rewards ecosystem. To start, let’s cover the welcome bonus, eligibility rules, and annual fee, since these are things that many cardmembers may be considering.
Welcome bonus of up to 80K points & $99 companion fare

The Atmos Rewards Ascent Card is offering a limited time welcome bonus where you’ll receive up to 80,000 bonus points and a $99 companion fare (plus taxes and fees from $23) with this offer. You’ll get 60,000 bonus points plus a $99 Companion Fare (plus taxes and fees from $23) after spending $3,000 or more on purchases within the first 90 days of opening your account. You can then earn an additional 20,000 bonus points after spending a total of $5,000 or more on purchases within the same 90-day period.

Based on my latest miles & points valuations , Atmos Rewards points are worth 1.5 cents each, given all the great uses there are of them . That means the 80,000 points are worth $1,200 for me. That doesn’t even account for the value of the companion fare, which could save you hundreds of dollars.

The Atmos Rewards Ascent Card is issued by Bank of America. The good news is that eligibility for this card is unrelated to having any other Atmos Rewards card, so you’re eligible for this card (including the bonus) if you have the business version of the card, the Atmos™ Rewards Visa Signature® Business Card ( learn more ), or the premium version of the card, the Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite ® Credit Card ( learn more ).

Bank of America doesn’t have too many consistent restrictions when it comes to getting approved for cards. The most consistent rule is that you can typically only be approved at most two Bank of America card in a two month period, three Bank of America cards in a 12 month period, and four Bank of America cards in a 24 month period (this applies to personal cards, not business cards).

There’s no consistent credit score you need in order to get approved for the Atmos Rewards Ascent Card. In general, I’d hope to have a score in the “good” to “excellent” range, ideally 700+ points. However, people with lower scores have been approved, and people with higher scores have been rejected.

The Atmos Rewards Ascent Card has a reasonable $95 annual fee. At right under $100, that’s in line with the annual fees you’ll find on many co-branded airline credit cards. You can add authorized users to the card at no extra cost (and there’s a reason you may want to do so, as I’ll cover below).

Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡是 Atmos Rewards 生态系统中更基本的个人卡。首先，让我们介绍一下欢迎奖金、资格规则和年费，因为这些是许多持卡会员可能会考虑的事情。
高达 80K 积分的欢迎奖金和 99 美元的同伴票价

根据我最新的里程和积分估值，Atmos 奖励积分每张价值 1.5 美分，因为它们有很多用途。这意味着 80,000 点积分对我来说价值 1,200 美元。这甚至没有考虑同伴票价的价值，这可以为您节省数百美元。

title_en: easyJet proceeds with Starlink Wi-Fi despite previous cost concerns
title_zh: 尽管之前存在成本问题，易捷航空仍继续使用 Starlink Wi-Fi
summary: easyJet will introduce Starlink Wi-Fi across its Airbus fleet despite stating earlier this year, following talks with SpaceX,… The post easyJet proceeds with Starlink Wi-Fi despite previous cost concerns appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 易捷航空将在其空客机队中引入 Starlink Wi-Fi，尽管今年早些时候曾表示，在与 SpaceX 谈判后，……易捷航空后程序
body_en: easyJet will introduce Starlink Wi-Fi across its Airbus fleet despite stating earlier this year, following talks with SpaceX, that the “economics aren’t quite working for us”.
On October 26, 2026, the British low-cost carrier announced that starting from the first half of 2027, Starlink installation will begin across the airline’s Airbus A320, A320neo and A321neo fleet.
easyJet said the roll out is expected to be completed by early 2028, allowing millions of passengers to access Elon Musk’s low-Earth orbit satellite powered connectivity.

The airline said in a statement that customers will be able to stream, game and browse on their own devices, just as they would when on the ground. There was no mention that the service would be free.
easyJet hopes that the move will attract even more business and leisure customers. The introduction will also put clear daylight between the service easyJet and rival budget airline Ryanair offers.
Ryanair CEO Michael O’Leary has shown no interest in adopting Starlink and was embroiled in a recent public social media spat with Musk over the cost.
In January 2026, easyJet CEO Kenton Jarvis expressed some concerns over the cost of Starlink for the airline but praised the product.
“When the time is right, we’ll pick the right service,” Jarvis said.
With the latest announcement, it appears that the numbers were now working for easyJet and will proceed with the investment.

“Innovation is in easyJet’s DNA and partnering with SpaceX to bring Starlink’s high-speed internet connectivity onboard for the first time will not only further enhance the experience we provide millions of customers, but means we are offering more of the options both business and leisure travellers want when they choose who they fly with,” Jarvis said.

He added: “Giving customers the opportunity to get online in the air will mean even greater choice and convenience when you fly with easyJet. Ultimately, it’s yet another way we’re making travel easy.”
Other low-cost carriers that have signed contracts for Starlink include Wizz Air, Frontier Airlines, and Volaris.
According to ch-aviation data, easyJet currently operates an active fleet of 78 A320-200s, 51 A32neos, and 22 A320neos.
The carrier also has 39 A319-100s, but these are gradually being replaced and will not feature Starlink, according to easyJet. The carrier is awaiting delivery of 120 A320neo and 151 A321neo.

“We’re proud to bring Starlink onboard easyJet and transform the way their customers stay connected throughout their travels,” Gwynne Shotwell, President and COO of SpaceX, said. “Fast, reliable connectivity from take-off to landing means people can work, stream, or stay in touch without interruption.”

body_zh: 易捷航空将在其空客机队中引入 Starlink Wi-Fi，尽管今年早些时候在与 SpaceX 谈判后表示“经济上对我们不太有利”。
2026 年 10 月 26 日，这家英国低成本航空公司宣布，从 2027 年上半年开始，该航空公司的空客 A320、A320neo 和 A321neo 机队将开始安装星链。
易捷航空表示，预计将于 2028 年初完成部署，使数百万乘客能够访问埃隆·马斯克的近地轨道卫星供电连接。
该航空公司在一份声明中表示，客户将能够在自己的设备上进行流媒体、游戏和浏览，就像在地面上一样。没有提到这项服务是免费的。
易捷航空希望此举能够吸引更多商务和休闲客户。此次推出也将在易捷航空和竞争对手瑞安航空提供的服务之间划清界限。
瑞安航空首席执行官迈克尔·奥利里（Michael O’Leary）对采用星链没有兴趣，并且最近卷入了与马斯克在公共社交媒体上就成本问题发生的争执。
2026 年 1 月，易捷航空首席执行官肯顿·贾维斯对该航空公司的星链成本表示了一些担忧，但对该产品表示赞赏。
“当时机成熟时，我们会选择合适的服务，”贾维斯说。
根据最新的公告，易捷航空的数据似乎正在发挥作用，并将继续进行投资。
贾维斯表示：“创新是易捷航空的基因，与 SpaceX 合作首次将 Starlink 的高速互联网连接带入机上，不仅将进一步增强我们为数百万客户提供的体验，而且意味着我们为商务和休闲旅客选择搭乘航班时提供更多选择。”
他补充道：“为客户提供空中上网的机会意味着乘坐易捷航空飞行时将有更多选择和便利。归根结底，这是我们让旅行变得轻松的另一种方式。”
其他与 Starlink 签署合同的低成本航空公司包括 Wizz Air、Frontier Airlines 和 Volaris。
根据ch-aviation的数据，易捷航空目前运营着一支由78架A320-200、51架A32neos和22架A320neo组成的现役机队。
据易捷航空称，该航空公司还拥有 39 架 A319-100 飞机，但这些飞机正在逐步更换，并且不会配备 Starlink 功能。该航空公司正在等待 120 架 A320neo 和 151 架 A321neo 交付。
SpaceX 总裁兼首席运营官格温·肖特韦尔 (Gwynne Shotwell) 表示：“我们很自豪能够将 Starlink 引入易捷航空，并改变客户在旅途中保持联系的方式。” “从起飞到着陆的快速、可靠的连接意味着人们可以不间断地工作、直播或保持联系。”
尽管之前存在成本问题，但易捷航空仍继续使用 Starlink Wi-Fi，这一问题首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

Home Military/Government/Police Aircraft Philippine Air Force Four pilots killed in Philippine Air Force training collision
Four pilots were killed when two Philippine Air Force SF-260 trainer aircraft collided in mid-air at Fernando Air Base, south of Manila, on Friday afternoon.

Both single-engine propeller aircraft came down within the base perimeter, with no casualties reported on the ground, Air Force spokesman Colonel Alvin Capinguian said in a statement released on Saturday.
The air force has opened an investigation into the collision and temporarily grounded its SF-260 fleet as a precaution. The circumstances of the accident have not been established.
The crash follows another fatal SF-260 training accident in May, when two military pilots were killed in Benguet province in the northern Philippines.

body_en: Western Sydney Airport welcomes first passenger flights - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Western Sydney Airport (WSI) Western Sydney Airport welcomes first passenger flights
Western Sydney International Airport opened to passengers on Sunday, 25 October, with a sold-out Jetstar service to the Gold Coast marking its first commercial departure.

Flight JQ362 took off shortly before 11:30 local time, following the opening of check-in at 08:00. A return service from the Gold Coast was scheduled to arrive at 15:00, followed by the airport’s first Melbourne departure at 18:00.

Located at Badgerys Creek, approximately 45 kilometres from central Sydney, the airport operates around the clock, offering an alternative to the curfew-restricted Sydney Kingsford Smith Airport. Cargo operations began in July.

Chief executive Simon Hickey described the opening as a generational change for Australian aviation. The initial terminal can handle about ten million passengers a year, a level the airport expects to reach in the early to mid-2030s.

Longer-term development, including additional terminals and a second runway, could increase capacity to 82 million passengers a year in the 2060s. These figures represent potential future capacity rather than opening-year traffic forecasts.

Hickey said passengers could have access to more than 250 destinations through connecting airline networks within just over a year. That figure includes onward connections and does not represent the number of nonstop routes from Western Sydney.

Approximately 10,000 people worked on the airport’s construction, around half from Western Sydney. The airport estimates that up to 8,500 jobs will support operations across the precinct once annual passenger numbers reach ten million.

title_en: Aer Lingus Completes Free Starlink Wi-Fi Rollout On Long Haul Fleet
title_zh: 爱尔兰航空在长途机队完成免费 Starlink Wi-Fi 部署
summary: Aer Lingus has installed free Starlink Wi-Fi on all 12 A330s and 14 A321s, finishing its long haul rollout well ahead of schedule. Short haul planes are next.
summary_zh: 爱尔兰航空已在所有 12 架 A330 和 14 架 A321 上安装了免费的 Starlink Wi-Fi，提前完成了远程部署。短途飞机
body_en: In November 2025, International Airlines Group (IAG) announced plans to introduce free Starlink Wi-Fi across the brand’s airlines, including British Airways, Iberia, and Aer Lingus.

In March 2026, we saw Aer Lingus equip its first aircraft (an Airbus A330) with Starlink Wi-Fi. There’s now an exciting update for the airline, as all long haul planes now feature the service. That’s fantastic news for those traveling transatlantic on the airline.

Aer Lingus is partnering with SpaceX to introduce Starlink Wi-Fi throughout its fleet, including on long haul and short haul aircraft. Best of all, Aer Lingus is offering Starlink Wi-Fi for free for all passengers. With this system, it’s possible to connect with multiple devices, including laptops, tablets, and smartphones.

Aer Lingus doesn’t even require you to be a member of its loyalty program in order to use the service, which is an area where IAG carriers are (generously) countering the industry trend, as other airlines are using Starlink as a way to drive loyalty program sign-ups.

Starlink is known for its high-speed, low-latency broadband internet, and the service is offered gate to gate. Starlink Wi-Fi allows for live streaming, productivity similar to on the ground (with high upload and download speeds), gaming, e-commerce, and more. Starlink is becoming increasingly popular with airlines, and we’ve seen dozens of airlines sign up for the service. As a passenger who values staying connected, I find Starlink to be a game changer .

Aer Lingus has just revealed that it has now installed Starlink Wi-Fi on all of its long haul aircraft. This includes all 12 Airbus A330s, as well as all 14 Airbus A321s (including both the A321LR and A321XLR variants). That means that all of Aer Lingus’ long haul fleet now features Starlink Wi-Fi.

The airline deserve huge credit for that rollout pace. Initially the carrier was planning on having Starlink on all long haul flights by the first quarter of 2027, then the timeline was moved forward to the end of 2026, and now the project has been wrapped up before the end of October. Kudos!
That’s the beauty of Starlink, because the actual installation process is really quick, once planes are certified to have the service.

With long haul aircraft now reconfigured, the plan is for short haul aircraft operating within Europe to get Starlink next, though the timeline for that remains to be seen. The airline has a total of 27 Airbus A320s and eight Airbus A320neos, so once that project starts, I’d expect it to only take a few months to complete, at most.

Aer Lingus is in the process of rolling out free Starlink Wi-Fi, and has done an impressive job so far. At this point all long haul aircraft, including Airbus A330s, A321LRs, and A321XLRs, feature Starlink. This is well ahead of the planned timeline, which was supposed to see the project complete by the first quarter of 2027.

Next up we can expect to see short haul Aer Lingus planes get Starlink, though the timeline for that remains to be seen. Unlike non-IAG carriers, Aer Lingus isn’t requiring passengers to be a member of the loyalty program to connect to the service.
What do you make of Aer Lingus introducing free Starlink Wi-Fi?
body_zh: 2025 年 11 月，国际航空集团 (IAG) 宣布计划在该品牌旗下的航空公司（包括英国航空、西班牙国家航空和爱尔兰航空）推出免费 Starlink Wi-Fi。
2026 年 3 月，我们看到爱尔兰航空为其第一架飞机（空客 A330）配备了 Starlink Wi-Fi。该航空公司现在有一个令人兴奋的更新，因为所有长途飞机现在都提供该服务。对于乘坐该航空公司跨大西洋旅行的人来说，这是个好消息。
爱尔兰航空正在与 SpaceX 合作，在其机队中引入 Starlink Wi-Fi，包括长途和短途飞机。最重要的是，爱尔兰航空为所有乘客免费提供 Starlink Wi-Fi。通过该系统，可以连接多种设备，包括笔记本电脑、平板电脑和智能手机。
爱尔兰航空甚至不要求您成为其忠诚度计划的会员即可使用该服务，而 IAG 航空公司在这一领域（慷慨地）逆袭了行业趋势，因为其他航空公司正在使用 Starlink 作为推动忠诚度计划注册的方式。
Starlink 以其高速、低延迟宽带互联网而闻名，并且该服务是门到门提供的。 Starlink Wi-Fi 可实现直播、类似于地面的生产力（具有高上传和下载速度）、游戏、电子商务等。星链越来越受到航空公司的欢迎，我们已经看到数十家航空公司注册了该服务。作为一名重视保持联系的乘客，我发现 Starlink 改变了游戏规则。
爱尔兰航空刚刚透露，目前已在其所有长途飞机上安装了 Starlink Wi-Fi。这包括所有 12 架空客 A330 以及所有 14 架空客 A321（包括 A321LR 和 A321XLR 型号）。这意味着爱尔兰航空的所有长途机队现在都配备了 Starlink Wi-Fi。
该航空公司的推出速度值得高度赞扬。最初，该航空公司计划在 2027 年第一季度之前在所有长途航班上安装 Starlink，后来将时间表提前到 2026 年底，现在该项目已在 10 月底前完成。荣誉！
这就是星链的美妙之处，因为一旦飞机被认证可以提供这项服务，实际的安装过程非常快。
随着长途飞机现已重新配置，计划是让欧洲境内运营的短途飞机下一步接入星链，但具体时间表仍有待观察。该航空公司总共拥有 27 架空客 A320 和 8 架空客 A320neo，所以一旦该项目开始，我预计最多只需要几个月就能完成。
爱尔兰航空正在推出免费的 Starlink Wi-Fi，迄今为止已经取得了令人印象深刻的成绩。目前，所有长途飞机，包括空客 A330、A321LR 和 A321XLR，都配备了 Starlink。这远远超出了计划时间表，该项目原定于 2027 年第一季度完成。
接下来，我们预计将看到爱尔兰航空的短途飞机接入星链，但具体时间仍有待观察。与非 IAG 航空公司不同，爱尔兰航空不要求乘客成为忠诚度计划的会员才能连接到该服务。

title_en: Airbus to discuss GPAC fighter opportunities with BAE Systems: FT
title_zh: 空中客车公司将与 BAE Systems 讨论 GPAC 战斗机机会：FT
summary: Airbus and BAE Systems are set for talks over possible opportunities for the European planemaker to play a… The post Airbus to discuss GPAC fighter opportunities with BAE Systems: FT appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 空中客车公司和 BAE 系统公司将就这家欧洲飞机制造商可能参与的机会进行谈判…… 空中客车公司讨论 GPAC 战斗机行动后
body_en: Airbus and BAE Systems are set for talks over possible opportunities for the European planemaker to play a role in the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), according to the Financial Times.

The GCAP fighter jet program is currently jointly led by the United Kingdom, Italy and Japan, but could also welcome Germany into the fold, after its own fighter project with France reached the end of the line earlier this year.
According to the Financial Times , talks between Airbus and the UK’s BAE Systems will take place in the following weeks, and include discussions around several options for potential collaboration.
Sources told the British newspaper that uncrewed autonomous Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) would also be an area of discussion.
GCAP is a joint venture led by BAE, Leonardo and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries along with companies such as Rolls Royce, MBDA and Avio Aero.

In an interview this month with Handelsblatt, Mike Schoellhorn, CEO of Airbus Defence and Space, said the company would want to take a “key role” in the project and “won’t just be making the fin or a wing”.
Some industry commentary has suggested that the program could be disrupted if Berlin pushed hard for a large design role, and a collaboration would need to be carefully managed.
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on October 8, 2026, that the UK was open to Germany joining GCAP.
“I’ve indicated to the chancellor our openness to Germany joining GCAP,” Burnham said, during a joint press conference with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz.
Prime Minister Burnham said he would seek to move the idea forward “in the coming period” with Italy and Japan.
An alternative option for Germany and Airbus is to partner up with Sweden’s Saab which builds the Gripen jet.
The post Airbus to discuss GPAC fighter opportunities with BAE Systems: FT appeared first on AeroTime .
body_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，空中客车公司和 BAE 系统公司将就这家欧洲飞机制造商在全球作战航空计划 (GCAP) 中发挥作用的可能机会进行谈判。
GCAP战斗机项目目前由英国、意大利和日本联合领导，但在今年早些时候德国与法国的战斗机项目结束后，也可能欢迎德国加入。
据英国《金融时报》报道，空中客车公司与英国 BAE Systems 之间的谈判将在接下来的几周内进行，其中包括围绕多种潜在合作方案进行讨论。
消息人士告诉英国报纸，无人驾驶的自主协作战斗机（CCA）也将成为讨论的一个领域。
GCAP 是一家由 BAE、Leonardo 和三菱重工以及劳斯莱斯、MBDA 和 Avio Aero 等公司牵头的合资企业。
空中客车防务与航天公司首席执行官迈克·舍尔霍恩(Mike Schoellhorn)本月接受《商报》采访时表示，该公司希望在该项目中发挥“关键作用”，“而不仅仅是制造鳍或机翼”。
一些行业评论认为，如果柏林大力推动大型设计角色，该计划可能会被扰乱，并且需要谨慎管理合作。
英国首相安迪·伯纳姆于 2026 年 10 月 8 日表示，英国对德国加入 GCAP 持开放态度。
伯纳姆在与德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨举行的联合新闻发布会上表示：“我已向德国总理表明，我们对德国加入 GCAP 持开放态度。”
伯纳姆总理表示，他将寻求与意大利和日本“在未来一段时间内”推进这一想法。
德国和空中客车公司的另一个选择是与瑞典萨博公司合作，该公司生产鹰狮喷气式飞机。

title_en: Philippines probes fatal SF-260 midair collision that killed four PAF pilots
title_zh: 菲律宾调查造成四名菲律宾空军飞行员死亡的 SF-260 空中相撞事故
summary: The Philippines’ Department of National Defense (DND) has opened an investigation into a crash involving two Philippine Air… The post Philippines probes fatal SF-260 midair collision that killed four PAF pilots appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 菲律宾国防部（DND）已对涉及两架菲律宾航空公司飞机的坠机事件展开调查……
body_en: The Philippines’ Department of National Defense (DND) has opened an investigation into a crash involving two Philippine Air Force (PAF) SF-260 trainer aircraft at Fernando Air Base in Lipa City, Batangas, on October 23, 2026, which killed all four pilots on board.

In a statement reported by The Philippine Daily Inquirer, the DND said the probe “will be conducted thoroughly and objectively to establish the facts, determine the causes, and identify any gaps that require corrective action and prevent similar tragedies.” The department added that it remains committed “to transparency, accountability, and ensuring the safety of our personnel.”
Probe to cover training, maintenance and command

Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said the investigation will cover flight planning, administrative procedures, pilot training, maintenance and command leadership. Investigators will also assess the attitude and aptitude of both the student and instructor pilots.

According to Teodoro, investigators will trace the aircraft’s maintenance records and preserve any parts that can be salvaged. They will also review the past performance of the pilots involved and carry out toxicology tests if samples are still available. Teodoro said toxicology examinations after fatal accidents are standard procedure and should not be skipped.

The Air Force Safety Office will lead the investigation. Teodoro told local reporters that the office had been strengthened to make it “almost independent” and is working with other experts, “so the truth about all accidents will come out. Nothing will be concealed.”
He added that the PAF is open to bringing in technical expertise from other agencies or partner countries if needed.
ABS-CBN News reported that Teodoro described this as the third such accident, raising the possibility of a systemic problem.

Asked whether the age of the fleet played a role, Teodoro said any findings on maintenance or modernization would be made public. He noted that age alone does not make an aircraft unsafe, pointing out that other armed forces operate even older trainers.

Teodoro cautioned against speculation while the investigation is underway. He warned that premature conclusions could unfairly implicate individuals or shield those responsible. He cited the US National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) as an example. “Even in the NTSB they’re very careful in releasing information because it must be factual and not speculative,” he said, as quoted by Inquirer.
Teodoro explained that the aircraft were conducting military training that includes close formation flying, a core tactical skill that reduces an aircraft group’s radar signature.
The accident happened at 15:51 local time on October 23, 2026, during a training flight involving two single-engine SF-260 aircraft.
Both aircraft came down within the base perimeter, and no other casualties were reported.

The PAF has grounded its entire SF-260 fleet as a precaution while the investigation continues. “The Philippine Air Force mourns the loss of four pilots in an aviation accident involving two SF-260 aircraft during a training flight at Fernando Air Base on October 23, 2026. We extend our heartfelt condolences to their bereaved families, loved ones, and fellow airmen,” the PAF said in a Facebook statement.
The PAF said it is assisting the families and asked the public to respect their privacy.

The accident came five months after another fatal SF-260 crash. On May 20, 2026, an SF-260 went down in Tuba, Benguet, after a long-range navigation training flight, killing an instructor pilot and her student.

body_zh: 菲律宾国防部 (DND) 已对 2026 年 10 月 23 日在八打雁利帕市费尔南多空军基地发生的两架菲律宾空军 (PAF) SF-260 教练机坠毁事件展开调查，事故造成机上四名飞行员全部遇难。
在《菲律宾每日问询者报》报道的一份声明中，国防情报局表示，调查“将彻底、客观地进行，以查明事实，查明原因，并找出需要采取纠正行动的任何漏洞，并防止类似悲剧发生。”该部门补充说，它仍然致力于“透明度、问责制和确保我们人员的安全”。
调查涵盖训练、维护和指挥
国防部长吉尔伯托·特奥多罗表示，调查将涵盖飞行计划、行政程序、飞行员培训、维护和指挥领导。调查人员还将评估学员和教员飞行员的态度和能力。
特奥多罗表示，调查人员将追踪飞机的维护记录，并保留任何可以回收的部件。他们还将审查相关飞行员过去的表现，并在仍有样本的情况下进行毒理学测试。特奥多罗说，致命事故后的毒理学检查是标准程序，不应跳过。
空军安全办公室将领导调查。特奥多罗告诉当地记者，该办公室已得到加强，使其“几乎独立”，并正在与其他专家合作，“因此所有事故的真相都会水落石出。不会隐瞒任何事情。”
他补充说，如有需要，PAF 愿意引进其他机构或合作伙伴国家的技术专业知识。
ABS-CBN 新闻报道称，特奥多罗称这是第三起此类事故，增加了出现系统性问题的可能性。
当被问及船队的年龄是否发挥了作用时，特奥多罗表示，任何有关维护或现代化的调查结果都将公开。他指出，仅年龄并不意味着飞机不安全，并指出其他武装部队使用的教练机甚至更旧。
特奥多罗警告在调查正在进行期间不要进行猜测。他警告说，过早的结论可能会不公平地牵连个人或保护那些负有责任的人。他以美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）为例。 《询问报》援引他的话说：“即使是国家运输安全委员会，他们在发布信息时也非常谨慎，因为信息必须是事实，而不是推测。”
特奥多罗解释说，这些飞机正在进行军事训练，其中包括近距离编队飞行，这是一种减少飞机群雷达信号的核心战术技能。
事故发生在当地时间2026年10月23日15时51分，当时两架单引擎SF-260飞机在一次训练飞行中。
两架飞机都在基地周边坠落，没有其他人员伤亡的报道。
作为预防措施，在调查继续进行期间，巴基斯坦空军已将其整个 SF-260 机队停飞。菲律宾空军在 Facebook 声明中表示：“2026 年 10 月 23 日，在费尔南多空军基地的一次训练飞行中，两架 SF-260 飞机发生空难，造成四名飞行员丧生，菲律宾空军对此表示哀悼。我们向他们的家人、亲人和飞行员同事表示衷心的哀悼。”
巴基斯坦空军表示正在协助这些家庭，并要求公众尊重他们的隐私。
这起事故发生在另一起致命的 SF-260 坠机事故发生五个月后。 2026 年 5 月 20 日，一架 SF-260 在完成远程导航训练飞行后在本格特的图巴坠毁，导致一名教机飞行员和她的学生丧生。

title_en: My Current Credit Card Portfolio: 26 Cards, $7,979 In Annual Fees (Ouch!)
title_zh: 我当前的信用卡组合：26 张卡，年费 7,979 美元（哎呀！）
summary: I currently have 26 credit cards open. Here's every card in my wallet, its annual fee, why I keep it, and which ones I plan to cancel.
summary_zh: 我目前有 26 张信用卡。这是我钱包中的每张卡、其年费、我保留它的原因以及我计划取消哪些卡。
body_en: It goes without saying that some of us take maximizing credit card rewards to the extreme, and that can include holding onto a lot of credit cards. In this post, I’d like to lay my cards on the table… no pun intended!

After all, maximizing credit cards is one of the best ways to elevate your travel. This can include getting the credit cards with the best welcome bonuses , maximizing your return on spending , and taking advantage of credit card perks .

There are a lot of misconceptions about the impact that applying for credit cards can have on your credit score. So I’d like to first address how applying for credit cards impacts your credit score (I have lots of cards, and my score is excellent), then I’ll talk about what goes into my credit card decision making process, and then I’ll share the cards I currently have open.

There are a lot of misconceptions about how credit scores work, in particular people thinking that applying for credit cards hurts your credit score . That’s generally not true, and in many cases applying for cards can even help your credit score in the long run.
For context, I have a lot of credit cards, and my credit score is almost perfect , in the top couple percent nationwide.
For those of you not familiar, here’s what factors into your credit score
35% of your score is your payment history (the percentage of payments you’ve made on-time)
30% of your score is your credit utilization (how much credit you’re using compared to your total limits)
15% of your score is your credit age (the average age of your open accounts)
10% of your score is the types of credit you use (how many different types of requests for credit you have)
10% of your score is your requests for new credit (how many times you’ve applied for credit)

What’s most important is that you pay your bills on time, don’t utilize too much of your credit (meaning you want to ideally use 20% or less of your total available credit, and/or pay your credit card bills early ), and keep some cards long term, which will help increase your average age of accounts.

The only metric that’s lowered by applying for cards is your requests for new credit, but that makes up just 10% of your score. Furthermore, credit inquiries typically fall off your report after 24 months.
Closing credit cards that are no longer working for you potentially doesn’t harm your credit much either, though alternatively you can also often downgrade credit cards instead .
What I look for when applying for credit cards
For me, there are three things I look for when applying for credit cards
Credit cards that offer a big welcome bonus — often the introductory bonuses on cards are compelling, and enough reason to pick up a new card

Credit cards that offer a generous return on spending — there are some cards you have because they help you maximize the points you earn , whether it’s for everyday spending, for specific spending categories , or for large purchases

Credit cards that offer perks that more than justify the annual fee — some cards are worth holding onto even if you don’t plan on putting much spending on them, because they offer things like elite status , annual free nights , etc.

body_zh: 不言而喻，我们中的一些人将信用卡奖励最大化发挥到了极致，这可能包括持有大量信用卡。在这篇文章中，我想摊开我的牌……没有双关语的意思！
毕竟，充分利用信用卡是提升旅行体验的最佳方式之一。这可以包括获得具有最佳欢迎奖金的信用卡、最大化您的支出回报以及利用信用卡优惠。
对于申请信用卡对信用评分的影响，存在很多误解。所以我想先讲一下申请信用卡对信用评分的影响（我有很多张卡，而且我的信用评分非常好），然后我会讲一下我的信用卡决策过程是怎样的，然后我会分享我目前开的卡。
关于信用评分的运作方式存在很多误解，特别是人们认为申请信用卡会损害您的信用评分。这通常是不正确的，在许多情况下，从长远来看，申请信用卡甚至可以帮助您提高信用评分。
就背景而言，我有很多信用卡，而且我的信用评分几乎是完美的，在全国排名前几位。
对于那些不熟悉的人，以下是影响您的信用评分的因素
您的分数的 35% 是您的付款历史记录（您按时付款的百分比）
分数的 30% 是您的信用利用率（您使用的信用量与总限额相比）
你的分数的 15% 是你的信用年龄（你开立账户的平均年龄）
您的分数的 10% 是您使用的信用类型（您有多少种不同类型的信用请求）
您分数的 10% 是您对新学分的请求（您申请学分的次数）
最重要的是，您按时支付账单，不要使用太多信用（这意味着您最好使用可用信用总额的 20% 或更少，和/或尽早支付信用卡账单），并长期保留一些卡，这将有助于提高您的平均账户年龄。
申请信用卡会降低的唯一指标是您对新信用的请求，但这仅占您分数的 10%。此外，信用查询通常会在 24 个月后从您的报告中消失。
关闭不再对您有用的信用卡可能也不会对您的信用造成太大损害，尽管您也可以经常降级信用卡。
申请信用卡时我要寻找什么
对我来说，申请信用卡时我会考虑三件事
提供巨额欢迎奖金的信用卡——通常卡上的介绍性奖金很有吸引力，并且有足够的理由选择一张新卡
提供丰厚消费回报的信用卡 - 您拥有某些卡是因为它们可以帮助您最大限度地赚取积分，无论是日常消费、特定消费类别还是大额购买
信用卡所提供的福利不仅仅证明年费是合理的——即使您不打算在上面花太多钱，有些卡也值得持有，因为它们提供诸如精英身份、年度免费住宿等服务。

body_en: Airbus forecasts 46% growth in global freighter fleet by 2045 - Aviation24.be
Home Manufacturers Airbus Airbus forecasts 46% growth in global freighter fleet by 2045

Airbus expects the worldwide dedicated freighter fleet to grow from 2,360 aircraft in 2026 to 3,460 by 2045, an increase of approximately 46%, driven by fleet replacement and expanding air cargo demand.

Its 2026 Cargo Global Market Forecast, presented at the Cargo Facts Symposium, estimates a requirement for 2,670 freighter deliveries over the period. Replacements will account for 1,580 aircraft, with a further 1,090 supporting growth.

Passenger-to-freighter conversions are expected to supply 1,700 aircraft, compared with 970 new-build freighters. By size, demand comprises 1,140 single-aisle aircraft, 860 medium widebodies and 670 large widebodies.

North America will lead demand with 925 deliveries, followed by Asia-Pacific with 850. Together, the regions represent approximately two-thirds of the total. Europe and the CIS will require 515 aircraft, Latin America 165, the Middle East 125 and Africa 90.

Airbus forecasts annual air cargo traffic growth of 3.2% over the next two decades, outpacing projected global trade growth of 2.9%. It identifies e-commerce, high-value technology shipments and the use of air freight as an alternative to maritime transport among the principal drivers.

Asia-Pacific is expected to remain the leading region for international air cargo traffic, with North American connections forming the largest market. Airbus sees opportunities for its A350F and passenger-to-freighter conversions across the A320, A321 and A330 families as operators replace older aircraft.
